shoxbetwest.us.title: Changing Lanes
shoxbetwest.us.description: A rush-hour fender-bender on New York City's crowded FDR Drive, under most circumstances, wouldn't set off a chain reaction that could decimate two people's lives. But on this day, at this time, a minor collision will turn two complete strangers into vicious adversaries. Their means of destroying each other might be different, but their goals, ultimately, will be the same: Each will systematically try to dismantle the other's life in a reckless effort to reclaim something he has lost. (Thriller, Drama, Action, Mystery, Adventure) - 2002

shoxbetwest.us.title: Sound of Violence
shoxbetwest.us.description: A young killer experiences intense pleasure whenever she hears the sound of human pain. (Horror, Thriller) - 2021

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Silent Planet
shoxbetwest.us.description: Serving a life sentence alone on a distant planet, an aging convict must confront his past when a new prisoner arrives and forces him to remember his life on Earth. (Science fiction, Thriller) - 2024

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Ghost and the Darkness
shoxbetwest.us.description: Sir Robert Beaumont (Tom Wilkinson) is behind schedule on a railroad in Africa. Enlisting noted engineer John Henry Patterson (Val Kilmer) to right the ship, Beaumont expects results. Everything seems great until the crew discovers the mutilated corpse of the project's foreman (Henry Cele), seemingly killed by a lion. After several more attacks, Patterson calls in famed hunter Charles Remington (Michael Douglas), who has finally met his match in the bloodthirsty lions. (Historical drama, Adventure, Action, Thriller, Drama) - 1996

shoxbetwest.us.title: Stand
shoxbetwest.us.description: Basketball star and social justice activist Mahmoud Abdul-Rauf endures a childhood of bullying due to Tourette's syndrome and is the target of hate speech and Islamophobia during his basketball career. (Special, Documentary, Basketball) - 2023-02-03

shoxbetwest.us.title: Ricky Powell: The Individualist
shoxbetwest.us.description: Photographer Ricky Powell captures the music, fashion and art scene in New York City in the 1980s and '90s. (Documentary) - 2020

shoxbetwest.us.title: Aurora: A Love Story
shoxbetwest.us.description: Kenny and Giselle are set to marry on a beach in Puerto Rico. Giselle disappears on the day of the ceremony, setting off a wild chain of events that unearths secrets, lies and betrayal, and threatens to destroy the fairy-tale love story. (Drama, Romance) - 2023

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Violent Heart
shoxbetwest.us.description: Long-buried secrets threaten to tear a couple apart. (Thriller, Drama) - 2020

shoxbetwest.us.title: Wild Wild West
shoxbetwest.us.description: When President Ulysses S. Grant (Kevin Kline) learns that diabolical inventor Dr. Arliss Loveless (Kenneth Branagh) is planning to assassinate him, he orders Civil War hero James West (Will Smith) and U.S. Marshal Artemus Gordon (also Kline) to arrest him. West's trigger-happy personality doesn't always mesh well with that of the thoughtful Gordon, but they manage to work together. And with the help of a mysterious stranger (Salma Hayek), West and Gordon close in on Loveless. (Action, Western, Comedy, Adventure, Science fiction) - 1999

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Killing of Kenneth Chamberlain
shoxbetwest.us.description: The events that led to the death of Kenneth Chamberlain Sr., an elderly African American veteran with bipolar disorder, who was killed during a conflict with police officers who were dispatched to check on him. (Thriller, Drama) - 2019

shoxbetwest.us.title: Regarding Us
shoxbetwest.us.description: After losing her teaching career in the Catholic school system, a transgender woman has a profound impact on the lives of two children, one with two fathers in marital strife, and the other a recent transplant from a conservative household. When the children form a unique bond, new questions and old prejudices erupt. (Drama, Comedy) - 2025

shoxbetwest.us.title: The Comeback Trail

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Peter Rabbit and his three sisters -- Flopsy, Mopsy and Cotton-Tail -- enjoy spending their days in Mr. McGregor's vegetable garden. When one of McGregor's relatives suddenly moves in, he's less than thrilled to discover a family of rabbits in his new home. A battle of wills soon breaks out as the new owner hatches scheme after scheme to get rid of Peter -- a resourceful rabbit who proves to be a worthy and wily opponent.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Peter Rabbit 2
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Despite his efforts, Peter can't seem to shake his reputation for mischief among the other rabbits. Once he adventures out of the garden Peter finds himself in a world where mischief is appreciated, but soon his family come to bring him home.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Borrowers
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A four-inch-tall family live beneath the floorboards of a human house. The family's future is threatened when the house falls into the hands of an evil lawyer who plans to destroy it.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Karate Kid: Legends
skycinemafamily.uk.description: After moving to New York City, kung fu prodigy Li Fong enters a karate competition -- but his skills alone aren't enough. With help from Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso, he soon learns to merge two styles into one for the ultimate martial arts showdown.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Witches
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Creepy fairy tale following the fortunes of a young orphan who becomes embroiled in a supernatural adventure. Brought up on his kindly grandmother's scary stories about witches, he stumbles on a real coven while on holiday. Overhearing their plans to capture all the children in Britain, he sets out to stop them, remaining undeterred throughout - even when he has been turned into a mouse.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Cinema List: Animal Antics
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Music and lights bring magic to life. From `Sing' to `The Bad Guys 2', enjoy animated animal adventures the whole family will love.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Babe
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Engaging family tale based on Dick King-Smith's classic story about an orphaned piglet which is adopted by a sheepdog and learns how to herd sheep. Babe at first seems destined to end up on the dining table at Christmas, but the farmer realises that the animal's unusual talent may bring him glory in the sheepdog trials.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Yogi Bear
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Yogi, Boo Boo, and Ranger Smith team up to try to stop the mayor from closing Jellystone Park and selling it to loggers.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: A Minecraft Movie
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A mysterious portal pulls four misfits into the Overworld, a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master the terrain while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected crafter named Steve.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Wicked: For Good
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Demonised as the Wicked Witch of the West, Elphaba lives in exile, while Glinda resides at the palace in Emerald City. As an angry mob rises against the Wicked Witch, she'll need to reunite with Glinda to transform herself, and all of Oz, for good.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A pregnant woman was deserted by her partner. When she goes into labour, a friendly taxi driver rushes her to hospital and the pair become firm friends. He slowly falls in love with her and her baby, but she's still looking for the perfect partner, not realising he's right under her nose. However, we can hear the baby's thoughts, and he wants the guy as his dad.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking Too
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A wisecracking toddler deals with toilet training, bickering parents and a baby sister in this sequel to the 1989 hit.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Look Who's Talking Now
skycinemafamily.uk.description: In the third of the 'Look Who's Talking' comedies, two dogs enter the Umbriacco household - and take an immediate dislike to each other. When Molly loses her job, husband James is forced to take on a demanding role as private airline pilot. The children miss him, so he buys a dog to cheer them up. However, when James's glamorous boss asks his family to look after her poodle, sparks fly between the dogs.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Journey 2: The Mysterious Island
skycinemafamily.uk.description: When young adventurer Sean Anderson receives a coded distress signal from an uncharted island, he sets out to find it and rescue its lone inhabitant before seismic shockwaves force the island under the sea and bury its treasures forever.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: Jumanji
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Alan Parrish disappeared as a young boy. Nobody believes his friend's story that he was sucked into the game they were playing. Twenty-six years later, two children find the game in their attic, and when they start to play, Alan is released, but the game isn't over yet, and Alan must finish before he is really free.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Karate Kid Part II
skycinemafamily.uk.description: Old rivalries and new adversaries await Daniel and Mr Miyagi as they travel to Okinawa to visit Miyagi's ailing father.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Karate Kid Part III
skycinemafamily.uk.description: A boy trained in the martial arts is alienated from his mentor just when he needs to prepare for a showdown with his arch-enemy. Instead, he turns to a Vietnam vet who teaches him how to fight dirty - a strategy the youth comes to realise is a mistake.

skycinemafamily.uk.title: The Karate Kid
skycinemafamily.uk.description: After moving to China, a twelve-year-old boy falls in love with one of his classmates. This soon comes to the attention of the class bully.

skycinemafamily.uk.description: A slick attorney fails to show up for his son's fifth birthday, prompting the boy to make a wish that his father would tell the truth for just one day. Miraculously, the wish is granted and for the next 24 hours, the formerly mendacious lawyer is unable to tell a single lie.

skycinemafamily.uk.description: When Gabby's dollhouse, her most prized possession, ends up in the hands of an eccentric cat lady named Vera, she sets off on an adventure through the real world to get the Gabby Cats back together before it's too late.

Unfortunately, Olaf is a cruel, scheming man only after the inheritance that the eldest Baudelaire, Violet, is set to receive. The children escape and find shelter with their quirky Uncle Monty and, subsequently, their phobic Aunt Josephine, but Olaf is never far behind.

The cats' leader, Mr Tinkles, plans to steal the serum, but first he must get past fearless dog agent Lou who, thanks to a mistake in recruitment, guards the Brody family.

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Catacombs
starzencoreclassic.us.description: A young woman in Paris goes to a party in the enormous labyrinth of limestone tunnels beneath Paris. When she becomes separated from her friends, she is convinced something is chasing her through the dark tunnels. (Horror, Thriller) - 2007

Earth's billions of inhabitants are unaware that the planet has an expiration date. With the warnings of an American scientist (Chiwetel Ejiofor), world leaders begin secret preparations for the survival of select members of society. When the global cataclysm finally occurs, failed writer Jackson Curtis (John Cusack) tries to lead his family to safety as the world starts falling apart. (Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2009

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Metamorphosis: The Alien Factor
starzencoreclassic.us.description: A computer-wise teen (Tara Leigh) and her valley-girl friend (Dianna Flaherty) take on a mutant-tissue monster at a lab. (Science fiction) - 1991

starzencoreclassic.us.title: Harlem Nights
starzencoreclassic.us.description: In the waning days of Prohibition, Sugar Ray (Richard Pryor) and his adopted son, Quick (Eddie Murphy), run a speakeasy called Club Sugar Ray. When gangster Bugsy Calhoune (Michael Lerner) learns that Sugar Ray's place is pulling in more money than his own establishment, the Petty Pat Club, he pays corrupt cop Phil Cantone (Danny Aiello) to close Club Sugar Ray down. Quick doesn't exactly help the situation when he falls for Calhoun's gun moll, Miss Dominique La Rue (Jasmine Guy). (Comedy, Crime drama, Romance, Adventure, Thriller) - 1989

starzencoreclassic.us.title: The Promise
starzencoreclassic.us.description: Brilliant medical student Michael (Oscar Isaac) meets beautiful dance instructor Ana (Charlotte Le Bon) in late 1914. Their shared Armenian heritage sparks an attraction that explodes into a romantic rivalry between Michael and Ana's boyfriend (Christian Bale), an American photojournalist who's dedicated to exposing the truth. As the Ottoman Empire crumbles into war-torn chaos, their conflicting passions must be deferred as they join forces to get themselves and their people to safety. (Historical drama, Romance) - 2016

starzencoreclassic.us.title: One Man's Justice
starzencoreclassic.us.description: When the wife and daughter of Army drill sergeant John North (Brian Bosworth) are killed during an arms deal involving a crooked FBI agent named Karl Savak (Bruce Payne), John decides to take matters into his own hands, only to discover that the henchman responsible for their deaths has been put into witness protection. Now, John must enlist the help of a street-smart kid named Mikey (DeJuan Guy) to infiltrate the city's criminal underground and get his own form of revenge. (Action) - 1995

starzencorewest.us.title: E.T. the Extra-Terrestrial
starzencorewest.us.description: After a gentle alien becomes stranded on Earth, the being is discovered and befriended by a young boy named Elliott. Bringing the extraterrestrial into his suburban California house, Elliott introduces E.T., as the alien is dubbed, to his brother and his little sister, Gertie, and the children decide to keep its existence a secret. Soon, however, E.T. falls ill, resulting in government intervention and a dire situation for both Elliott and the alien. (Family, Science fiction, Adventure) - 1982

starzencorewest.us.title: Clueless
starzencorewest.us.description: Shallow, rich and socially successful Cher (Alicia Silverstone) is at the top of her Beverly Hills high school's pecking scale. Seeing herself as a matchmaker, Cher first coaxes two teachers into dating each other. Emboldened by her success, she decides to give hopelessly klutzy new student Tai (Brittany Murphy) a makeover. When Tai becomes more popular than she is, Cher realizes that her disapproving ex-stepbrother (Paul Rudd) was right about how misguided she was -- and falls for him. (Comedy, Romance) - 1995

starzencorewest.us.title: Mamma Mia!
starzencorewest.us.description: Donna, an independent hotelier in the Greek islands, is preparing for her daughter's wedding with the help of two old friends. Meanwhile, Sophie, the spirited bride, has a plan. She secretly invites three men from her mother's past in hope of meeting her real father and having him escort her down the aisle on her big day. (Musical comedy) - 2008

starzencorewest.us.title: Sahara
starzencorewest.us.description: Seasoned adventurer Dirk Pitt (Matthew McConaughey) sets out for the African desert with his sarcastic companion (Steve Zahn) in search of a ship rumored to have vanished long ago, the main draw being the treasure supposedly hidden within the lost vessel. When the daring duo come across a beautiful scientist (Penélope Cruz) who is juggling an escape from a warlord and a mission to stop the spread of a powerful plague, their desert expedition begins to heat up. (Adventure, Action) - 2005

Dressed as police in the mistaken belief that they were to attend a costume party, Ryan and Justin find that the uniforms earn them much respect and attention. Although Justin is uncomfortable with the idea, Ryan decides to continue with the charade, putting them both in increasingly dangerous situations. (Comedy, Action) - 2014

starzencorewest.us.description: A squad of six Black soldiers, led by ex-slave Barabbas, are sent on a suicide mission. (Action, Drama, Horror) - 2025

starzencorewest.us.title: Stranger on Horseback
starzencorewest.us.description: A circuit judge (Joel McCrea) rides in to break a ruthless cattle baron's stranglehold on a frontier town. (Western) - 1955

starzencorewest.us.title: The Family Fang
starzencorewest.us.description: An actress and her brother investigate the mysterious disappearance of their parents, two performance artists known for their hoaxes. (Comedy drama, Mystery) - 2015

starzencorewest.us.title: Death Race
starzencorewest.us.description: Framed for a murder he did not commit, three-time speedway champ Jensen Ames (Jason Statham) finds himself at Terminal Island, the country's toughest prison, but he gets an unexpected chance at freedom when the warden offers a choice: Compete in the Death Race as a mythical driver called Frankenstein, or rot in a cell forever. Riding in a car equipped with flamethrowers and grenade launchers, Ames must survive a gauntlet of vicious criminals to win his freedom -- or die trying. (Action, Thriller) - 2008

starzencorewest.us.title: Death Race 3: Inferno
starzencorewest.us.description: Only one victory away from winning his freedom, legendary driver Carl Lucas (Luke Goss) enters the first Death Race to take place in the brutal Kalahari Desert. (Action, Thriller, Science fiction) - 2012

starzencorewest.us.title: I Can Only Imagine 2
starzencorewest.us.description: After the breakout success of the song "I Can Only Imagine," MercyMe's Bart Millard is living the dream with sold-out arenas, a devoted fan base, and a thriving career. However, Millard's past soon threatens the family he's built, especially the fragile bond with his son, Sam. (Drama, Music) - 2026

starzencorewest.us.title: The Italian Job
starzencorewest.us.description: After a heist in Venice, Steve turns on his partners in crime, killing safecracker John Bridger and keeping all the gold for himself; the rest of the team, including leader Charlie Croker, driver Handsome Rob, explosives man Left Ear and tech geek Lyle, vows revenge; they enlist the help of Bridger's daughter, Stella, and plot to recover the gold from Steve's Los Angeles mansion. (Crime drama, Thriller, Action) - 2003

starzencorewest.us.title: Assault on Precinct 13
starzencorewest.us.description: While en route to prison, a bus carrying criminals Marion (Laurence Fishburne), Beck (John Leguizamo) and Anna (Aisha Hinds) is rerouted to Detroit's soon-to-be-closed Precinct 13 because of a dangerous winter storm. All communications with the outside world are cut off, and Jake (Ethan Hawke), an emotionally volatile police sergeant who is haunted by his past, is forced to work with the criminals in order to survive an attack on the precinct by a group of armed men. (Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 2005

starzencorewest.us.title: Trouble Man
starzencorewest.us.description: A former cop turned private investigator gets hired to find a missing R&B star. His investigation uncovers a connection to a larger conspiracy, forcing him to question those around him and his own past. (Action) - 2025

starzencorewest.us.title: The Parts You Lose
starzencorewest.us.description: A fugitive forms an unlikely bond with a deaf child when he takes refuge in an abandoned barn on the boy's family's farm. (Drama, Thriller) - 2019

starzencorewest.us.title: Eye for an Eye
starzencorewest.us.description: Grieving the sudden death of her parents, Anna relocates from New York to a small Florida town to live with the grandmother she's never met. Isolated and in unfamiliar surroundings, she falls in with a couple of local teens, but when she becomes a bystander to an unforgivable act of violence, she finds herself ensnared by Mr. Sandman, the twisted soul of a tormented child who haunts bullies' dreams before feasting on their eyeballs when they finally wake. (Horror) - 2025

(Action, Crime drama, Thriller) - 2005

starzencorewest.us.title: SIGN OFF
starzencorewest.us.description: Sign off. (Special) - 2005-10-13

starzencorewest.us.title: The Back-up Plan
starzencorewest.us.description: Tired of waiting for Mr. Right while her biological clock ticks away, Zoe (Jennifer Lopez) decides it's time to make an appointment at the sperm bank. On the same day as her procedure, she meets Stan (Alex O'Loughlin), a man with the potential to be her ideal mate. When Stan learns that Zoe's unpredictable behavior is the result of her pregnancy, he declares his commitment. As the due date approaches, both lovers realize that they really don't know each other without a baby in the picture. (Romantic comedy) - 2010

starzencorewest.us.title: Beast
starzencorewest.us.description: After years away from the cage, a once-feared MMA champion is pulled back in for the fight of his life when his younger brother is put in danger. Reuniting with the trainer who once made him a legend, he commits to one final showdown against the reigning title-holder: a brutal fighter determined to dismantle the ex-champ's legacy in front of the world. Pushed to his breaking point, the contender's stakes are simple: win, or lose everything he's built. (Action, Drama) - 2026

starzencorewest.us.title: Pain & Gain
starzencorewest.us.description: Danny Lupo (Mark Wahlberg), manager of the Sun Gym in the 1990s Miami, decides that there is only one way to achieve his version of the American dream: extortion. To achieve his goal, he recruits musclemen Paul (Dwayne Johnson) and Adrian (Anthony Mackie) as accomplices. After several failed attempts, they abduct rich businessman Victor Kershaw (Tony Shalhoub) and convince him to sign over all his assets to them. But when Kershaw makes it out alive, authorities are reluctant to believe his story. (Action, Comedy drama) - 2013

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Dead Ringer
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Identical twin sisters Margaret (Bette Davis) and Edith Philips (also Davis) haven't spoken in nearly 20 years, ever since Margaret hoodwinked the man Edith loved into marrying her instead. When Margaret's husband dies, Edith reunites with her twin -- but only to seek revenge. Killing her sister and stealing her identity, Edith has everyone convinced she's really Margaret. But when she encounters Margaret's lover, Tony (Peter Lawford), Edith uncovers a shocking secret that threatens her plans. (Mystery) - 1964

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Bad Seed
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Air Force Colonel Kenneth Penmark (William Hopper) and his wife, Christine (Nancy Kelly), dote on their pig-tailed daughter, Rhoda (Patty McCormack) -- as does their lonely landlady, Monica Breedlove (Evelyn Varden). But self-centered Rhoda has a secret tendency for selfishness and loves to accumulate gifts, whether given or stolen, in her room. Christine keeps her knowledge of her daughter's darker side to herself, but when a schoolmate of Rhoda's dies mysteriously, her self-deception unravels. (Horror) - 1956

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Back Street
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Based on Fanny Hurst's classic novel of the star-crossed romance between a prominent married man and an Ohio farm woman. (Drama) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: King of Jazz
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: This lost film found in 1970 features dance numbers, pioneer special effects, animation, the Rhythm Boys with Bing Crosby. (Musical) - 1930

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Katana: The Oath of the Sword
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Ambitious young Masao leaves his lover Hisa in Japan to study abroad at the University of California, Berkeley. Unable to cope, Hisa eventually marries another man. (Drama) - 1914

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Apart From You
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Two geisha deal with life's hardships. (Drama) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Three Colors: Red
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Part-time model Valentine (Irène Jacob) meets a retired judge (Jean-Louis Trintignant) who lives in her neighborhood after she runs over his dog. At first the judge gifts Valentine with the dog, but her possessive boyfriend won't allow her to keep it. When she returns with the dog to the judge's house, she discovers him listening in on his neighbors' phone conversations. At first Valentine is outraged, but her debates with the judge over his behavior soon leads them to form a strange bond. (Drama) - 1994

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Camera Buff
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A Polish factory worker (Jerzy Stuhr) embraces filmmaking after recording his daughter's birth. (Comedy) - 1979

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Tugboat Annie
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Annie Brennan (Marie Dressler) is one of the Pacific Northwest's best skippers, though her drunk husband, Terry (Wallace Beery), is no help. Annie's son, Alec (Robert Young), an industrious student, becomes the youngest ship's master on the Pacific Coast and gets engaged to his boss' daughter. Terry continues to drink heavily, causing an accident in his stupor that makes Alice lose her boat. Angry with his father, Alec refuses to talk to his parents until, in trouble at sea, he needs their help. (Comedy drama) - 1933

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Emma
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Middle-aged housekeeper Emma (Marie Dressler) helps a lonely widower, Ronald Smith (Richard Cromwell) raising his spoiled and over-entitled children. When Smith takes Emma on a vacation, he makes his feelings for her known by proposing marriage. Emma happily accepts, but tragedy strikes when Smith dies of a heart attack shortly after. Emma is devastated, but then must face Smith's children, who suspect she may have been involved in the death of their father. (Drama) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Vanity Fair
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: A 19th-century story, now updated to the 1930s, tells of an irrepressible and intelligent Englishwoman who is determined to advance her position. (Drama) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Wet Parade
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Alcohol and Prohibition catch up to the patriarchs (Walter Huston, Lewis Stone) of two families, North and South. (Drama) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: New Morals for Old
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Proper parents have a son (Robert Young) who wants to go to Paris, and a daughter (Margaret Perry) in love with a married man. (Comedy) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Love Me Tonight
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this stylish musical comedy, Maurice Courtelin (Maurice Chevalier), a French tailor, travels to the castle of nearby royalty to collect payment on long overdue bills. A series of mishaps force Courtelin to pose as a baron while he tries to woo the elegant Princess Jeanette (Jeanette MacDonald). Resistant to Courtelin's charms at first, she eventually becomes intrigued by him. However, when the truth gets out about Courtelin's humble identity, he risks losing the only woman that he loves. (Musical comedy) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Thirteen Women
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Female alumnae of the St. Albans Seminary sorority group receive letters from Swami Yogodachi, making alarming predictions of death and murder -- which come true. When Helen Frye (Kay Johnson) receives her prediction, she contacts sorority leader Laura Stanhope (Irene Dunne), who invites the remaining members to come to her home. On the journey there, Helen meets Ursula Georgi (Myrna Loy), a half-Indian, unaware that Ursula's fury over her treatment in college is behind the swami's predictions. (Thriller) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Mask of Fu Manchu
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The sinister Dr. Fu Manchu (Boris Karloff) and his equally devious daughter, Fah Lo See (Myrna Loy), clash with a British expedition that has set out in search of Genghis Khan's tomb. Working under the guidance of Sir Nayland Smith (Lewis Stone), the English team finds ancient relics -- a mask and a sword. While the group seeks the artifacts for their archeological value, Fu Manchu and Fah Lo See regard them as mystical items that they can use to gain unstoppable power. (Horror) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Animal Kingdom
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Successful and passionate publisher Tom Collier (Leslie Howard) marries socialite Cee Henry (Myrna Loy) despite loving his open-minded mistress, Daisy Sage (Ann Harding). As Tom becomes an established member of the upper class, his deceitful wife convinces him to publish books solely for profit and sacrifice his intellectual pursuits. When Daisy sees what Tom has become, she criticizes his transformation, forcing him to choose between staying with Cee and following his heart. (Drama) - 1932

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Thin Man
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The recently divorced Gilbert discovers that his new girlfriend has stolen $50,000 and is carrying on with other men. Not long afterward, he disappears. Anxious to locate her father, Gilbert's daughter goes to private detective Nick Charles for help. (Comedy drama) - 1934

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: After the Thin Man
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Recently returned home from vacation, private detective Nick Charles (William Powell) and his socialite wife, Nora (Myrna Loy), are back on the case when Nora's cousin, Selma (Elissa Landi), reports her husband Robert (Alan Marshal) missing. As the duo search for the disreputable Robert, Selma's friend David Graham (James Stewart), who secretly pines for her, aids the investigation. When the three begin to unravel Robert's secret life, the missing persons case turns into one of murder. (Comedy drama) - 1936

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Another Thin Man
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In this third film in the Thin Man series based on characters created by mystery writer Dashiell Hammett, retired detective Nick Charles and his wife, Nora, accept an invitation to visit family friend Col. Burr MacFay at his Long Island, N.Y., estate. Soon after arriving with their new son, Nick Jr., and family dog Asta in tow, MacFay is murdered, and the Charles family must unravel a mystery that may implicate the most unlikely of suspects. (Comedy drama) - 1939

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Shadow of the Thin Man
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In San Francisco, retired Detective Nick Charles and his attractive wife, Nora, learn from police Lt. Abrams of the murder of a race jockey, but Nick refuses to get involved. Approached later by athletics commission head Maj. Jason Scully and reporter Paul Clarke, Nick still declines to investigate. When another reporter is murdered and Paul is arrested, Nick gives way to Nora's plea and, with their fox terrier Asta, sets out to solve the murders. (Comedy drama, Romance, Mystery) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Thin Man Goes Home
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Famous retired detective Nick Charles (William Powell) takes his wife, Nora (Myrna Loy), and their dog, Asta, to visit Nick's parents in their small, quiet town. Determined that Nick's father respect Nick's profession, Nora urges him to find a crime to investigate, unaware that Nick's presence has already frightened spy Edgar Draque (Leon Ames) into action. After Nora buys a painting for Nick's birthday and the artist is murdered, Nick discovers that the murder is connected to espionage. (Comedy drama) - 1944

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Song of the Thin Man
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Tommy Drake (Philip Reed), a musician aboard a gambling ship, is shot and killed while trying to break into a safe. Later, amateur sleuths Nick (William Powell) and Norah (Myrna Loy) receive a visit from Phil Brant, Drake's former boss and the main suspect in his murder. After they give Brant up to the authorities, they start digging around for clues. The pair question Brant's wife and one of Drake's musician colleagues until they start to piece together the intricate puzzle. (Comedy, Crime drama, Mystery) - 1947

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Calling Dr. Kildare
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Senior physician Dr. Gillespie (Lionel Barrymore) sends his student, the overconfident intern James Kildare (Lew Ayres), to work in the dispensary with nurse Mary Lamont (Laraine Day). There, a man unwilling to go to emergency pleads with Kildare to examine his friend, who has been shot. Kildare treats and hides the wounded man, whom he learns is a murder suspect. Smitten by the victim's attractive sister, Rosalie (Lana Turner), Kildare offers to help prove her brother's innocence. (Drama) - 1939

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Foreign Correspondent
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Crime reporter John Jones (Joel McCrea) is turning in nothing but dull copy. His editor, unhappy with his work, hopes a change of scenery will be the thing Jones needs to get back on track. Re-assigned to Europe as a foreign correspondent, Jones is very much out of his element. When he stumbles on a spy ring, he feels ill-equipped to unravel the truth alone, and he seeks help from a beautiful politician's daughter (Laraine Day) and an urbane English journalist (George Sanders). (Thriller) - 1940

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: The Bad Man
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: After an outlaw, Pancho Lopez (Wallace Beery), steals cattle from the ranch of Gil (Ronald Reagan) and his uncle Henry (Lionel Barrymore), they face foreclosure to banker Hardy (Henry Travers). When Gil's old love, Lucia (Laraine Day), shows up, her husband (Tom Conway) wants to buy the land, believing there is oil on it. However, Pancho soon arrives and kidnaps everyone except Gil. Pancho realizes that Gil had previously saved his life, so he attempts to help Gil get back on track. (Western) - 1941

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Journey for Margaret
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: In the midst of war-torn London, American journalist John Davis (Robert Young) and his wife, Nora (Laraine Day), lose their unborn baby in a bombing raid. The resultant surgery leaves Nora barren, and, while she returns to the United States to recuperate, John stays in England. When he takes young orphans Margaret (Margaret O'Brien) and Peter (William Severn) under his wing, John decides that he wants to remove the children from harm's way and bring them home to America. (Drama) - 1942

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Mr. Lucky
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: Joe Adams (Cary Grant) is as clever as they come. Certain that he'll be called up during World War II, Joe nabs the draft papers of a man who's been freed from service and leverages his position into a potentially lucrative scam. The captain of a commercial ship, Joe cons war volunteer Dorothy Bryant (Laraine Day) into believing that he's planning a fund drive for the troops. In fact, he's got something more devious in mind. But as Joe rethinks things, he finds his ruse is already in motion. (Comedy drama) - 1943

turnerclassicmovies.us.title: Bride by Mistake
turnerclassicmovies.us.description: The staggeringly wealthy Norah Hunter (Laraine Day), a shipyard owner, too often finds herself the romantic target of gold-digging men. To attract a suitor whose main interest is not money, she changes places with her secretary, Sylvia Lockwood (Marsha Hunt), and assumes the role of a young working woman. However, she then falls for recuperating fighter pilot Anthony Travis (Alan Marshal), who, in turn, is madly in love with Sylvia -- or, perhaps, with the millions he thinks she has. (Drama) - 1944

themoviechannel.us.title: There Will Be Blood
themoviechannel.us.description: Silver miner Daniel Plainview (Daniel Day-Lewis) leads a hardscrabble life with his son, H.W. (Dillon Freasier). When he hears about oil oozing from the ground near the Western town of Little Boston, Daniel takes his son on a mission to find their fortune. Daniel makes his lucky strike and becomes a self-made tycoon but, as his fortune grows, he deviates into moral bankruptcy. (Drama) - 2007

themoviechannel.us.title: The Untouchables
themoviechannel.us.description: After building an empire with bootleg alcohol, legendary crime boss Al Capone (Robert De Niro) rules Chicago with an iron fist. Though Prohibition agent Eliot Ness (Kevin Costner) attempts to take Capone down, even his best efforts fail due to widespread corruption within the Windy City's police force. Recruiting an elite group of lawmen who won't be swayed by bribes or fear, including Irish-American cop Jim Malone (Sean Connery), Ness renews his determination to bring Capone to justice. (Crime drama) - 1987

themoviechannel.us.title: Million Dollar Baby
themoviechannel.us.description: Frankie Dunn (Clint Eastwood) is a veteran Los Angeles boxing trainer who keeps almost everyone at arm's length, except his old friend and associate Eddie "Scrap Iron" Dupree (Morgan Freeman). When Maggie Fitzgerald (Hilary Swank) arrives in Frankie's gym seeking his expertise, he is reluctant to train the young woman, a transplant from working-class Missouri. Eventually, he relents, and the two form a close bond that will irrevocably change them both. (Drama) - 2004

themoviechannel.us.title: Escape From Alcatraz
themoviechannel.us.description: Frank Morris (Clint Eastwood), a hardened con with a history of prison breaks, is sent to serve the rest of his life sentence at Alcatraz -- America's most infamously brutal and inescapable maximum security prison. Morris quickly realizes the prison's dehumanizing effects and clashes with its cruel warden (Patrick McGoohan). Fed up with life at Alcatraz, Morris and two convict brothers (Fred Ward, Jack Thibeau) meticulously plan the unthinkable: an escape from the island. (Thriller, Action, Historical drama) - 1979

themoviechannel.us.title: The Mechanic
themoviechannel.us.description: One of an elite group of assassins, Arthur Bishop (Jason Statham) may be the best in the business. Bishop carries out his assignments with precision, detachment and adherence to a strict code, but when Harry (Donald Sutherland), his close friend and mentor, is murdered, Bishop vows revenge. Harry's son (Ben Foster) comes to him with vengeance in his heart and a desire to learn Bishop's trade, signaling the birth of a deadly partnership. (Action, Thriller, Drama) - 2011

themoviechannel.us.title: The Snowman
themoviechannel.us.description: For Detective Harry Hole, the death of a young woman during the first snowfall of winter feels like anything but a routine homicide. His investigation leads him to "The Snowman Killer," an elusive sociopath who continuously taunts Hole with cat-and-mouse games. As the vicious murders continue, Harry teams up with a brilliant recruit to try and lure the madman out of the shadows before he can strike again. (Thriller, Mystery, Crime drama) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: The Crow
themoviechannel.us.description: The night before his wedding, musician Eric Draven (Brandon Lee) and his fiancée are brutally murdered by members of a violent inner-city gang. On the anniversary of their death, Eric rises from the grave and assumes the gothic mantle of the Crow, a supernatural avenger. Tracking down the thugs responsible for the crimes and mercilessly murdering them, Eric eventually confronts head gangster Top Dollar (Michael Wincott) to complete his macabre mission. (Action, Fantasy) - 1994

themoviechannel.us.title: The Time Traveler's Wife
themoviechannel.us.description: Chicago librarian Henry De Tamble (Eric Bana) suffers from a rare genetic disorder that causes him to drift uncontrollably back and forth through time. On one of his sojourns, he meets the love of his life, Clare (Rachel McAdams), and they marry. But the problems and complexities of any relationship are multiplied by Henry's inability to remain in one time and place, so that he and his beloved are continually out of sync. (Romance, Drama, Science fiction) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: Teaching Mrs. Tingle
themoviechannel.us.description: A hardworking and bright high-school senior, Leigh Ann (Katie Holmes) has her impending status as valedictorian jeopardized when her bitter history teacher, Mrs. Tingle (Helen Mirren), gives her a poor grade on a project. This antagonistic relationship quickly escalates until circumstances lead Leigh Ann and her friends Luke (Barry Watson) and Jo Lynn (Marisa Coughlan) to hold Tingle hostage in her home. As the conflict continues, it looks as if not everyone will make it out alive. (Comedy) - 1999

themoviechannel.us.title: Fist Fight
themoviechannel.us.description: On the last day before summer vacation, high school teacher Andy Campbell tries his best to keep it together amid senior pranks, a dysfunctional administration and budget cuts that threaten his job. Things go from bad to worse when he crosses Ron Strickland, the school's toughest and most feared teacher. When Strickland gets fired, he challenges Campbell to a fight after school. As news of the showdown spreads like wildfire, poor Andy desperately seeks any way out of his date with certain doom. (Comedy) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Marathon Man
themoviechannel.us.description: Thomas "Babe" Levy (Dustin Hoffman) is a Columbia graduate student and long-distance runner who is oblivious to the fact that his older brother, Doc (Roy Scheider), is a government agent chasing down a Nazi war criminal (Laurence Olivier) -- that is, until Doc is murdered and Babe finds himself knee-deep in a tangle of stolen gems and sadistic madmen. Even his girlfriend, Elsa (Marthe Keller), becomes a suspect as everything Babe believed to be true is suddenly turned upside down. (Thriller, Action, Mystery, Drama, War) - 1976

themoviechannel.us.title: No Country for Old Men
themoviechannel.us.description: While out hunting, Llewelyn Moss (Josh Brolin) finds the grisly aftermath of a drug deal. Though he knows better, he cannot resist the cash left behind and takes it with him. The hunter becomes the hunted when a merciless killer named Chigurh (Javier Bardem) picks up his trail. Also looking for Moss is Sheriff Bell (Tommy Lee Jones), an aging lawman who reflects on a changing world and a dark secret of his own, as he tries to find and protect Moss. (Crime drama, Thriller, Western) - 2007

themoviechannel.us.title: Terms of Endearment
themoviechannel.us.description: Widow Aurora Greenway (Shirley MacLaine) and her daughter, Emma (Debra Winger), have a strong bond, but Emma marries teacher Flap Horton (Jeff Daniels) against her mother's wishes. When the marriage grows sour due to Flap's cheating, Emma eventually splits from him, returning to her mother, who is involved with a former astronaut (Jack Nicholson). Soon, Emma learns that she has terminal cancer. In the hospital, supported by Aurora, she tries to make peace with Flap and her children. (Comedy drama) - 1983

themoviechannel.us.title: Smoke Signals
themoviechannel.us.description: Arnold (Gary Farmer) rescued Thomas (Evan Adams) from a fire when he was a child. Thomas thinks of Arnold as a hero, while Arnold's son Victor (Adam Beach) resents his father's alcoholism, violence and abandonment of his family. Uneasy rivals and friends, Thomas and Victor spend their days killing time on a Coeur d'Alene reservation in Idaho and arguing about their cultural identities. When Arnold dies, the duo set out on a cross-country journey to Phoenix to retrieve Arnold's ashes. (Comedy drama) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: Daddy's Home
themoviechannel.us.description: Brad Whitaker (Will Ferrell) is a kindhearted radio executive who wants to be the best possible stepfather to his wife's (Linda Cardellini) two children. When her freewheeling ex-husband, Dusty (Mark Wahlberg), breezes back into town, Brad's feeling of insecurity quickly develops into an inferiority complex. As Dusty demonstrates his flair for athletics, home repair and bad-boy charisma, Whitaker finds himself in a no-holds-barred battle to one-up his rival and win the approval of his family. (Comedy) - 2015

themoviechannel.us.title: Tommy Boy
themoviechannel.us.description: After his beloved father (Brian Dennehy) dies, dim-witted Tommy Callahan (Chris Farley) inherits a near-bankrupt automobile parts factory in Sandusky, Ohio. His brand-new stepmother, Beverly (Bo Derek), wants to cash out and close, but Tommy's sentimental attachment to his father's employees spurs him to make one last-ditch effort to find someone who will buy their products. With his father's tightly wound assistant, Richard (David Spade), in tow, Tommy hits the road to scare up some new clients. (Comedy, Adventure) - 1995

themoviechannel.us.title: Office Christmas Party
themoviechannel.us.description: When the CEO (Jennifer Aniston) tries to close her hard-partying brother's (T.J. Miller) branch, he and his chief technical officer (Jason Bateman) must rally their co-workers and host an epic office Christmas party in an effort to impress a potential client and close a sale that will save their jobs. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2016

themoviechannel.us.title: Life During Wartime
themoviechannel.us.description: Nothing comes easily for Joy (Shirley Henderson) and her sisters, Trish (Allison Janney) and Helen (Ally Sheedy). Joy, unhappy with her job and her sleazy husband (Michael Kenneth Williams), is haunted by her dead boyfriend's ghost (Paul Reubens). Trish's pedophile husband (Ciarán Hinds) is behind bars, and she's ready to move on with her life. As an increasingly bitter Helen approaches middle age with a failing screenwriting career, it becomes clear her mother offers little comfort. (Comedy drama) - 2009

themoviechannel.us.title: The Foreigner
themoviechannel.us.description: Quan is a humble London businessman whose long-buried past erupts in a revenge-fueled vendetta when the only person left for him to love -- his teenage daughter -- dies in a senseless act of politically motivated terrorism. His relentless search to find the terrorists leads to a cat-and-mouse conflict with a British government official whose own past may hold the clues to the identities of the elusive killers. (Action, Thriller) - 2017

themoviechannel.us.title: Vanilla Sky
themoviechannel.us.description: Tom Cruise and Cameron Crowe reunite after "Jerry Maguire" for "Vanilla Sky," the story of a young New York City publishing magnate who finds himself on an unexpected roller-coaster ride of romance, comedy, suspicion, love, sex and dreams in a mind-bending search for his soul. (Thriller, Drama, Romance, Science fiction, Mystery) - 2001

themoviechannel.us.title: A Perfect Murder
themoviechannel.us.description: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect. (Thriller) - 1998

themoviechannel.us.title: We Were Soldiers
themoviechannel.us.description: Based upon the best-selling book "We Were Soldiers Once ... and Young" by Lt. Gen. Harold G. Moore (Ret.) and journalist Joseph L. Galloway, this compelling war drama depicts the true story of the first major battle between the United States and North Vietnamese forces. It is a film about uncommon valor and nobility under fire, loyalty among soldiers, and the heroism and sacrifice of men and women both home and abroad. (War, Historical drama) - 2002

themoviechannel.us.title: Faster
themoviechannel.us.description: Following a 10-year prison stint, Driver (Dwayne Johnson) sprints through the gates to take vengeance on those responsible for his brother's murder. Within hours of dispatching his first one, he has two men on his tail: a veteran police officer (Billy Bob Thornton) and an eager assassin (Oliver Jackson-Cohen). Driver tries to stay a step ahead of his pursuers, but there are hints that his list is incomplete, and the unknown person may endanger his life. (Action, Thriller) - 2010

themoviechannel.us.title: Body Cam
themoviechannel.us.description: While investigating the murder of a fellow officer, veteran Renee Lomito discovers a mysterious figure in the body cam footage. Haunted by visions of the event, she suspects something supernatural is targeting the cops in her unit. Now, in a race against time to find the one person who can stop these killings, Renee uncovers a sinister secret among the police force surrounding the shooting and cover-up of an unarmed youth. (Horror, Thriller) - 2020

wupadt.us.title: Beyond the Gates ᴺᵉʷ
wupadt.us.description: "Beyond the Gates" is set in a leafy Maryland suburb just outside of Washington D.C., and in one the most affluent African American counties in the United States. At the center of this community are the Duprees, a powerful and prestigious multi-generational family that is the very definition of Black royalty. But behind these pristine walls and lush, manicured gardens are juicy secrets and scandals waiting to be uncovered. And those that live outside these gates are watching closely. These are the places where the characters live, love, work and play. Those who have "made it" and those who haven't are all trying to navigate life -- and some with more grace than others. waga.us.title: The Simpsons ᴺᵉʷ
waga.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

waga.us.title: Animal Control ᴺᵉʷ

Leading the crew is Frank, an opinionated, eccentric animal control officer who may not have gone to college but is still the most well-read person in the room. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals. (Sitcom, Animals) - 2023-02-16

waga.us.title: Universal Basic Guys ᴺᵉʷ

waga.us.title: Grimsburg ᴺᵉʷ
waga.us.description: Marvin Flute may be the greatest detective ever to catch a cannibal clown or correctly identify a mid-century modern armoire. But there's one mystery he still can't crack -- his family. Now that he's back in Grimsburg, a town where everyone has a secret or three, Flute follows every lead he's got to redeem himself with the ex-wife he never stopped loving, even if it means hanging out with the son he never bothered to get to know. (Animated, Sitcom) - 2024-01-07

wbbm.us.description: The Newmans and the Abbotts represent Genoa City's upper class. Powerful businessman Victor Newman runs Newman Enterprises and has never stopped loving his former flame and wife, Nikki Reed Newman. Jack Abbott and his sister, Ashley, are closely connected with the Newman family, both personally and professionally. The battle supreme in Genoa City has been going on for years between Katherine Chancellor and Jill Foster Abbott. The Winters family, Williams family and recent newcomers round out the socially and ethnically diverse town. (Soap) - 1973-03-26

wbbm.us.title: Beyond the Gates ᴺᵉʷ
wbbm.us.description: "Beyond the Gates" is set in a leafy Maryland suburb just outside of Washington D.C., and in one the most affluent African American counties in the United States. At the center of this community are the Duprees, a powerful and prestigious multi-generational family that is the very definition of Black royalty. But behind these pristine walls and lush, manicured gardens are juicy secrets and scandals waiting to be uncovered. And those that live outside these gates are watching closely. These are the places where the characters live, love, work and play. Those who have "made it" and those who haven't are all trying to navigate life -- and some with more grace than others. (Soap, Drama) - 2025-02-24

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: James Martin's Spanish Adventure
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E12 Cadiz James is shown around Cadiz by Jose Pizarro. They visit the food market and Sherry Triangle, then eat by the sea. James explores the salt flats and they cook at Jose's villa.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Torres Strait At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: E1 Pickled Octopus Torres Strait Islander chef and owner of Mabu Mabu, Nornie Bero, cooks and talks through some of her favourite easy recipes, from quick picked octopus to fresh baked damper.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Yes, Chef!
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 The Pursuit Of Perfection The chefs make a dish worthy of a high-end restaurant that shows off their creativity and technique, but they won't be cooking these dishes themselves.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Bring A Plate
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Keyma's Empanadas Keyma shares her recipe for empanadas, a popular Venezuelan street food. Discover some of the ingredients that you can use inside this crunchy and mouth-watering snack food.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Precious Flavours
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Pousse-Pied In Spain's Galicia, fishermen sometimes risk their lives for a few kilos. Accidents, strictly controlled fishing, theft and smuggling complete the portrait.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: River Cottage: Veg
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E5 Power Hugh whips up a delicious vegetarian pasta dish to feed a group of outdoor swimmers. Plus, he makes a tasty stew with duck eggs, paprika and saffron.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour China Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Li Hongzhang's Chop Suey Adam Liaw embarks on an epic journey across China, discovering the country's vast, rich culture of food, travel and history.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Luke Nguyen's Memories Of Street Food
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: Luke starts his street food adventure in the chaotic streets of Saigon with a traditional Vietnamese pork breakfast before heading down the street and getting wowed by a local doughnut stall.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Jamie At Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E12 Winter Salads A quick trip around Jamie's vegetable garden produces an army of colourful ingredients to make inspired winter salads.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lidia's Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E6 Eggs And My Chickens As a child, Lidia's courtyard was home to several animals. She recollects those memories and creates a medley of ingredients for chopped salad, chicken cacciatore, and potato egg frico.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Pati's Mexican Table
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S13 E6 Paquime & Pecans Pati visits a haven of Chihuahuan culture and learns what makes their pecans so delicious.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Vegetables Mark makes vegetables the star and shows us how to treat them with care and attention to let their glorious flavours shine. Making pot roast cauliflower, vegetable dahl, and some tricks with beetroot.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Lorraine Pascale: Be A Better Cook
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Sonia Harwood With plenty of deceptively easy recipes and fantastic tips, Lorraine Pascale shows people with no kitchen confidence how to pull off an impressive meal for friends and family.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eater's Guide To The World
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Planting Roots In Tijuana Mexico Local, regular, newcomer -- whoever you are, Tijuana has something delicious for you to eat. Grab a seat and try the craft beer, pork belly tacos, and Caesar salad. Trust us, you'll want to stay.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E8 Broome: Ali & Mitch Mushroom Chicken with Vermicelli and Gubinge Custard - Mushroom and Chicken is a popular dish in Kriol cooking. Handed down by families who had a Chinese connection, this dish has many variations.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: People Of The North
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E5 Ryfylke: Vikings, Jazz, And Herring Dive into the diverse culture of Ryfylke, where Viking history, jazz festivals, and seafood culture intersect.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E11 Episode 11 Award-winning chef Mod joins Laura in the market to make delicious Vietnamese Rice Paper Rolls. Laura then whips up a naughty Tim Tam Doughnut, followed by a guilt-free Carrot Banana Cake.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E11 Ramen Around Tuscany Rachael prepares a hearty and healthy meal for her Italian friends, combining storebought and homemade ingredients to make flavourful, protein-rich ramen bowls.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E5 Mornington Peninsula Hayden is on the Mornington Peninsula in Victoria where he catches up with his good friend Dani Venn for some local tips and adventure. Things start on the water with mussel farmer Harry.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E1 Episode 1 Ashley Alexander creates a gooey Vegan Caramel, Date and Fresh Ginger Self-Saucing Pudding that will leave you wanting more.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E6 Episode 6 of Season 9 Laura shares her easy homemade granola recipe; Catherine makes cauliflower hummus; Laura makes some chocolate truffles.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E4 Episode 4 Rick visits Cartmel in the Lake District, famous for its racecourse, its ancient 13th Century Priory and Jean Johns' sticky toffee pudding.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E35 Episode 35 Guest Travis Harvey puts a twist on Spinach and Ricotta Fillo, while Justine prepares some Penne with Gorgonzola Speck and Walnuts, and Coconut Custard with Berries for dessert!

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E68 Smart Choices Adam enlists two award-winning sustainability champions, chef Jo Barrett, and director Damon Gameau, to make a menu of smart choices.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Nigella Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E13 Safety In Numbers It is Christmas, and Nigella is having a fabulous easy drinks party. On the menu there are meltingly tender turkey meatballs in tomato sauce and a must-have party recipe.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Stories
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E13 Yorkshire In God's own country, Rick discovers the history of the Yorkshire pud and how best to make it. He visits the UK's biggest tofu factory and cooks delicious veggie dishes at home.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Tom Kerridge Cooks Spain
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Vinegar And Avocados Chef Tom Kerridge is on the road in his bespoke vintage food truck in Andalucia to meet food producers who are just as obsessed with growing ingredients as he is about cooking them.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Marion Grasby's Flavours: Heart And Home
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E6 Thai Street Food At Home Marion returns to Bangkok to share the street food favourites she craves when away - pork dumplings, chicken rice, and noodle soup - then shows how to recreate these comforting dishes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: The Layover
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E1 Chicago Grandiose architecture, Italian Beef, Cubs versus White Sox, taverns galore, and the best meat in tube form in all of America find their way into Tony's layover.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Destination Flavour Japan Bitesize
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E1 Hokkaido Some of your favourite moments and recipes from Adam Liaw's culinary and cultural journey through Japan from its frozen north, to cherry-blossomed mainland and tropical sun-soaked south.

SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E7 Trieste's International Flavors The city of Trieste always filled Lidia with excitement. She cooks recipes inspired by her Zia Nina - mussels triestine, orange raspberry spritz, and a coffee panna cotta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Pati's Mexican Table
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S13 E7 The Magic Of Mata Ortiz Pati visits the village of Mata Ortiz to learn about the exquisite pottery it's known for.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Mark Moriarty: Off Duty Chef
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Bread And Desserts Chef Mark loves baking and working in the pastry section in top restaurants. He creates four recipes - chocolate honeycomb squares, buttery garlic brioche bread, focaccia, then a chocolate souffle.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eater's Guide To The World
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E7 Taking Off In America You eat at an airport because you have to, not because you want to. But just beyond the departure terminals you'll find smoky BBQ, sweet fluffy pancakes and a bowl of warm borbor-all worth it.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Kriol Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E9 Broome: Ali & Mitch Torres Final Episode Kangaroo Stew with bacon, soya & vegetables & Kangaroo Satays with a Spicy Chilli Peanut Sauce: Ali & Mitch draw on their family influences from the Djugan/Gooniyandi & Philipino & Malay heritage.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: People Of The North
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E6 Bugoynes: Little Finland In Norway Journey to Bugoynes, a remote fishing village at the edge of Norway, where Finnish heritage and Arctic traditions thrive.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E12 Episode 12 Things get a little risky when Laura makes Fermented Chilli Oil. Third-generation farmer Catherine Velisha adds some Veggies to Charlie Carrington's Spiced Rump Cap.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rachael Ray In Tuscany
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E12 Pollo Al Mattone Rachael prepares a traditional pollo al mattone, an Italian roast chicken, by generously seasoning spatchcock chickens, cooking them in a pan with a brick wrapped in tin foil.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Taste Of Australia With Hayden Quinn
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S6 E6 Yarra Valley Still in Victoria, Hayden is off to the Yarra Valley to find juicy apples from Montagues before heading up the range to try his hand at trout fishing, and of course we'll be dropping into a winery.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet: Sweet Edition
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S3 E2 Episode 2 Today we're celebrating diverse flavours.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: My Market Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E7 Episode 7 Laura starts her day making her Bircher Muesli with a twist, before her Italian heritage comes out with a delicious Creamy Roasted Capsicum Pasta.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Rick Stein's Food Heroes
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E5 Episode 5 Rick visits Cork in Southern Ireland. At the English Market, the gastronomic heart of the city, he talks to retailers and cooks Corned Beef and Cabbage. Still in Eire, he travels up the east coast.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Everyday Gourmet With Justine Schofield
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S9 E36 Episode 36 Justine and Guest Darren show some of their classic staple recipes including Mexican Mac and Cheese, Curried Scrambled Eggs and Coffee and Cacao Maple Granola Clusters.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: The Cook Up With Adam Liaw
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S8 E69 Special Treats Two very special guests, comedian Alex Ward and dessert legend Adriano Zumbo, join Adam in the kitchen for a night full of very special treats.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Eva Pau's Asian Kitchen
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E3 Episode 3 Eva proves that speedy cooking doesn't mean sacrificing flavour. She kicks off with Chinese Style Garlic Butter Spaghetti, a garlicky, rich pasta that's ready in minutes.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Memory Bites With Matt Moran
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E3 Christine Anu Chef Matt Moran and Christine Anu celebrate her Torres Strait Islander heritage through cherished dishes, heartfelt memories, and a moving exchange of culture and connection.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Breaking Bread with Tony Shalhoub
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S1 E4 Tokyo Tony's first visit to Tokyo launches him into the world of meticulously crafted Japanese breads: guided by the practice of 'Kaizen', a philosophy of continuous improvement that permeates the culture.

SBSFoodSydney.au.title: Anthony Bourdain: The Layover
SBSFoodSydney.au.description: S2 E2 Paris Tony visits one of his favourite cities in the world, Paris. It's hard to do too much of anything when your cup's being constantly refilled with amazing wine and there's a cheese plate to turn to.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E12 Resurrection of the Daleks: Part 2 As survivors of the prison station fight the invaders, Dalek agents on Earth take steps to protect the time corridor being used by the Doctor's friends.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E13 Planet of Fire: Part 1 On the planet Sarn, the truth about the god Logar is being searched for, while on Earth Peri wants a break from her stepfather. But the Master has other plans for everyone.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E14 Planet of Fire: Part 2 Kamelion has taken the TARDIS to Sarn and is trying to locate his master, while the Doctor explores the mystery of the Misos Triangle - much to Turlough's consternation.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E15 Planet of Fire: Part 3 Logar is angry and the volcano shakes with his displeasure – according to Timanov, who demands sacrifices to appease his god. Peri discovers the Master's whereabouts.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E16 Planet of Fire: Part 4 The Doctor is forced to take drastic measures against Kamelion and the Master to stop Sarn being completely destroyed by the numismaton gas that has been released.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E17 The Caves of Androzani: Part 1 Gunrunners are on Androzani Minor, supplying the rebellious android-builder Sharez Jek with munitions to help his attempts to return to power. But not everyone is happy about that.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E18 The Caves of Androzani: Part 2 Military captive Salateen tells Peri and the Doctor they are dying from spectrox tomaemia and the only cure is the milk of the queen bat, who sleeps deep below the caverns.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E19 The Caves of Androzani: Part 3 As Morgus continues to plot his political future on Androzani Major, Sharez Jek insanely believes Peri will fall in love with him. The Doctor is caught by the gunrunners.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E20 The Caves of Androzani: Part 4 Morgus is ruined, exposed as the one funding Jek’s gunrunners, and Jek himself goes on a murderous rampage. Although dying from spectrox tomaemia the Doctor saves Peri.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E21 The Twin Dilemma: Part 1 The mysterious Professor Edgeworth has kidnapped twin human child genii, Romulus and Remus, and Hugo Lang holds the new Doctor responsible for the destruction of his spaceship.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E22 The Twin Dilemma: Part 2 On Jaconda, Mestor’s cruel domination over the planet's population continues while on Titan Three, the Doctor seems to have been blown up in a booby-trapped building.

BBCSelect.us.title: Classic Doctor Who
BBCSelect.us.description: S21 E23 The Twin Dilemma: Part 3 Mestor claims that all he wants is for the Sylvest twins to help him repopulate his home planet but the Doctor knows there’s more to this than meets the eye.

kpix.us.description: "Beyond the Gates" is set in a leafy Maryland suburb just outside of Washington D.C., and in one the most affluent African American counties in the United States. At the center of this community are the Duprees, a powerful and prestigious multi-generational family that is the very definition of Black royalty. wdaf.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdaf.us.title: Animal Control ᴺᵉʷ

Leading the crew is Frank, an opinionated, eccentric animal control officer who may not have gone to college but is still the most well-read person in the room. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals. (Sitcom, Animals) - 2023-02-16

wdaf.us.title: Universal Basic Guys ᴺᵉʷ

wdaf.us.title: Grimsburg ᴺᵉʷ

ksas.us.title: The Simpsons ᴺᵉʷ
ksas.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

ksas.us.title: Animal Control ᴺᵉʷ
ksas.us.description: A group of local animal control workers' lives are complicated by the fact that animals are simple, but humans are not. Leading the crew is Frank, an opinionated, eccentric animal control officer who may not have gone to college but is still the most well-read person in the room. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals. (Sitcom, Animals) - 2023-02-16

ksas.us.title: Universal Basic Guys ᴺᵉʷ
ksas.us.description: Universal Basic Guys centers on two brothers, Mark and Hank Hoagies, who lose their jobs to automation and are given $3,000 a month in a new basic income program. Now, they're using their free time and free money to find purpose in a world where they're no longer needed. (Animated, Sitcom) - 2024-09-08

ksas.us.title: Grimsburg ᴺᵉʷ
ksas.us.description: Marvin Flute may be the greatest detective ever to catch a cannibal clown or correctly identify a mid-century modern armoire. But there's one mystery he still can't crack -- his family. Now that he's back in Grimsburg, a town where everyone has a secret or three, Flute follows every lead he's got to redeem himself with the ex-wife he never stopped loving, even if it means hanging out with the son he never bothered to get to know. (Animated, Sitcom) - 2024-01-07

The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals. (Sitcom, Animals) - 2023-02-16

wdrb.us.title: The Simpsons
wdrb.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wdrb.us.title: Young Sheldon
wdrb.us.description: For young Sheldon Cooper, it isn't easy growing up in East Texas. Being a once-in-a-generation mind capable of advanced mathematics and science isn't always helpful in a land where church and football are king. And while the vulnerable, gifted and somewhat naive Sheldon deals with the world, his very normal family must find a way to deal with him. His father, George, is struggling to find his way as a high school football coach and as father to a boy he doesn't understand. Sheldon's mother, Mary, fiercely protects and nurtures her son. For 12 years on "The Big Bang Theory," audiences came to know the iconic, eccentric and extraordinary Sheldon Cooper. In "Young Sheldon," audiences get a chance to meet him in childhood, as he embarks on his innocent, awkward and hopeful journey toward the man he will become. Jim Parsons, who plays the adult version of Sheldon on "The Big Bang Theory," narrates. (Sitcom) - 2017-09-25

wgmb.us.title: The Simpsons ᴺᵉʷ
wgmb.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wgmb.us.title: Animal Control ᴺᵉʷ

Leading the crew is Frank, an opinionated, eccentric animal control officer who may not have gone to college but is still the most well-read person in the room. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals. (Sitcom, Animals) - 2023-02-16

wgmb.us.title: Grimsburg ᴺᵉʷ

wofl.us.title: The Simpsons ᴺᵉʷ
wofl.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wofl.us.title: Animal Control ᴺᵉʷ
wofl.us.description: A group of local animal control workers' lives are complicated by the fact that animals are simple, but humans are not. Leading the crew is Frank, an opinionated, eccentric animal control officer who may not have gone to college but is still the most well-read person in the room. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals. (Sitcom, Animals) - 2023-02-16

wofl.us.title: Universal Basic Guys ᴺᵉʷ
wofl.us.description: Universal Basic Guys centers on two brothers, Mark and Hank Hoagies, who lose their jobs to automation and are given $3,000 a month in a new basic income program. Now, they're using their free time and free money to find purpose in a world where they're no longer needed. (Animated, Sitcom) - 2024-09-08

wofl.us.title: Grimsburg ᴺᵉʷ
wofl.us.description: Marvin Flute may be the greatest detective ever to catch a cannibal clown or correctly identify a mid-century modern armoire. But there's one mystery he still can't crack -- his family. Now that he's back in Grimsburg, a town where everyone has a secret or three, Flute follows every lead he's got to redeem himself with the ex-wife he never stopped loving, even if it means hanging out with the son he never bothered to get to know. (Animated, Sitcom) - 2024-01-07

The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. wvbt.us.description: This long-running animated comedy focuses on the eponymous family in the town of Springfield in an unnamed U.S. state. The head of the Simpson family, Homer, is not a typical family man. A nuclear-plant employee, he does his best to lead his family but often finds that they are leading him. The family includes loving, blue-haired matriarch Marge, troublemaking son Bart, overachieving daughter Lisa and baby Maggie. Other Springfield residents include the family's religious neighbor, Ned Flanders, family physician Dr. Hibbert, Moe the bartender and police chief Clancy Wiggum. (Animated, Sitcom) - 1989-12-17

wvbt.us.title: Animal Control ᴺᵉʷ

Leading the crew is Frank, an opinionated, eccentric animal control officer who may not have gone to college but is still the most well-read person in the room. In his past life as a cop, Frank tried to expose corruption in his department, but his efforts got him fired, leaving him cynical and curmudgeonly. Despite his rough exterior, he is blessed with an almost superhuman ability to understand animals. (Sitcom, Animals) - 2023-02-16

wvbt.us.title: Grimsburg ᴺᵉʷ
