fxm.us.title: Aliens
fxm.us.description: After floating in space for 57 years, Lt. Ripley's shuttle is found by a deep space salvage team. Upon arriving at LV-426, the marines find only one survivor, a nine-year-old girl named Newt. But even these battle-hardened marines with all the latest weaponry are no match for the hundreds of aliens that have invaded the colony. (Science fiction, Horror, Action, Adventure) - 1986

fxm.us.title: Underwater
fxm.us.description: Disaster strikes more than six miles below the ocean surface when water crashes through the walls of a drilling station. Led by their captain, the survivors realize that their only hope is to walk across the sea floor to reach the main part of the facility. But they soon find themselves in a fight for their lives when they come under attack from mysterious and deadly creatures that no one has ever seen. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller, Action) - 2020

fxm.us.title: Dawn of the Planet of the Apes
fxm.us.description: Ten years after simian flu wiped out much of the world's Homo sapiens, genetically enhanced chimpanzee Caesar and his ever-growing band of followers has established a thriving colony just outside San Francisco in Muir Woods. Meanwhile, a small band of human survivors emerges, which forces Caesar -- as leader -- to grapple with the dual challenge of protecting his people and re-establishing a relationship with the remaining human population -- the latter being Caesar's secret wish. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure) - 2014

fxm.us.title: The Neptune Factor
fxm.us.description: When an earthquake on the ocean floor causes an underwater laboratory to fall into a deep trench and places the scientists' lives in peril, Cmdr. Adrian Blake (Ben Gazzara) embarks on a rescue mission in his small experimental submarine. Along with a crew that includes Dr. Leah Jansen (Yvette Mimieux) and diver Don MacKay (Ernest Borgnine), Blake attempts to save the scientists from the unexplored depths, while encountering gigantic sea creatures that threaten their survival. (Science fiction) - 1973

fxm.us.title: The Ox-Bow Incident
fxm.us.description: In this classic Western, wanderers Gil Carter (Henry Fonda) and Art Croft (Henry Morgan) ride into a small Nevada town plagued by cattle thieves. Initially suspected of being the rustlers themselves, Carter and Croft eventually join a posse out to get the criminals, who also may be involved in a recent shooting. When the posse closes in on a group that could be the fugitives, they must decide on a course of action, with numerous lives hanging in the balance. (Western) - 1943

fxm.us.title: The Gang's All Here
fxm.us.description: The night before his deployment in World War II, wealthy heir Andy Mason (James Ellison) falls in love with Eadie (Alice Faye), a beautiful cabaret singer. The two hit it off, but Mason fails to reveal the fact that he has already promised to marry Vivian (Sheila Ryan), a family friend. When he returns from the war a hero, his father throws a huge party for him, hiring Eadie and her company to perform. Mason hopes to find an out with Vivian in order to marry his true love. (Musical, Romance) - 1943

fxm.us.title: Caprice
fxm.us.description: An industrial spy (Doris Day) for a cosmetics firm falls for another (Richard Harris) who may not be on her side. (Comedy) - 1967

fxm.us.title: Bedazzled
fxm.us.description: Stanley Moon (Dudley Moore) is a bumbling short-order cook, infatuated with Margaret (Eleanor Bron), the statuesque waitress he works with at Wimpy Burger in London. On the verge of suicide, he meets George Spiggott (Peter Cook), the devil, who, in return for his soul, grants him seven wishes to woo the challenging Margaret. Despite the wishes and the advice of the Seven Deadly Sins, including Lilian Lust (Raquel Welch), Stanley can't seem to win his love and shake the meddling Spiggott. (Comedy) - 1967

fxm.us.title: The Gods Must Be Crazy
fxm.us.description: The tribal people in a remote African desert live a happy life, but it is all torn to pieces when a Coca-Cola bottle falls from a plane. With the villagers fighting over the strange foreign object, tribal leader Xi (N!xau) decides to take the bottle back to the gods to restore peace. His journey to the "end of the world" eventually has him crossing paths with a bumbling scientist (Marius Weyers) and a band of guerrillas who take a schoolteacher (Sandra Prinsloo) and her class hostage. (Comedy) - 1981

fxm.us.title: Cocoon
fxm.us.description: Oscar-winning fantasy in which the residents of a Florida rest home get a new lease of life when they stumble across an alien "fountain of youth" in a disused holiday home. Unbeknown to them, aliens have been using the swimming pool in the house to store their cocooned brethren, giving the waters a powerful, rejuvenating quality. (Fantasy) - 1985

fxm.us.title: Aliens vs. Predator: Requiem
fxm.us.description: Residents (Steven Pasquale, Reiko Aylesworth, John Ortiz) of Gunnison, Colorado, are caught up in the crossfire when two deadly extraterrestrial species bring their longstanding conflict to Earth. On the one side, nearly indestructible Aliens; on the other, a lone Predator whose mission is to wipe out all traces of the Alien infestation from Earth, no matter who gets in the way. (Science fiction, Horror, Thriller, Action) - 2007

fxm.us.title: Predator
fxm.us.description: Dutch, a soldier of fortune, is hired by the U.S. government to secretly rescue a group of politicians trapped in Guatemala. But when Dutch and his team, which includes weapons expert Blain and CIA agent George, land in Central America, something is wrong. After finding a string of dead bodies, the crew discovers they are being hunted by a brutal creature with superhuman strength and the ability to disappear into its surroundings. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 1987

fxm.us.title: Predator 2
fxm.us.description: Los Angeles is enduring a heat wave and a crime wave, so the pressure on police officer Michael Harrigan to solve a strange string of murders is mounting. Harrigan thinks the culprit can be found among the warring gangs and drug cartels, but FBI Special Agent Peter Keyes knows the horrible truth: Their killer is a fearsome extraterrestrial with keen hunting abilities that include superior night vision and the power to make itself invisible. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Horror) - 1990

fxm.us.title: Predators
fxm.us.description: Brought together on a mysterious planet, a mercenary (Adrien Brody) and a group of cold-blooded killers now become the prey. A new breed of aliens pursues the ragtag humans through dense jungle. The group must work together to survive, or become the latest trophies of the fearsome intergalactic hunters. (Science fiction, Action, Adventure, Thriller) - 2010

fxm.us.title: Alien vs. Predator
fxm.us.description: When the wealthy and ambitious Charles Bishop Weyland funds an expedition to Antarctica, he hopes to find a mysterious source of heat that has been detected. Led by a tough guide, Alexa Woods, Weyland and his team uncover a pyramid, but they also find malevolent parasitic aliens. Making matters worse, another extraterrestrial species, known as Predators, arrive to hunt the other aliens, with the humans caught in the middle of the conflict. (Science fiction, Horror, Action, Adventure) - 2004

fxm.us.title: The Adventures of Hajji Baba
fxm.us.description: A clever Persian barber (John Derek) wows the harem and wins a princess (Elaine Stewart) by saving her from an evil prince. (Adventure) - 1954

fxm.us.title: The Egyptian
fxm.us.description: In ancient Egypt, Sinuhe (Edmund Purdom) is a would-be doctor who saves the life of a young man (Michael Wilding) suffering from a seizure. When the afflicted youth awakes, he introduces himself as the Pharaoh Akhnaton and makes Sinuhe the royal healer. While working at his new, prestigious post, Sinuhe suffers through a botched romance and the death of his adoptive parents. Despondent, he leaves the Pharaoh's court to bury his loved ones, and, in the process, incurs the wrath of Akhnaton. (Historical drama) - 1954

fxm.us.title: The 300 Spartans
fxm.us.description: Xerxes of Persia invades Greece with his army; Leonidas (Richard Egan) of Sparta fights back at Thermopylae. (Historical drama) - 1962

fxm.us.title: The Lion
fxm.us.description: Living an idyllic existence on a Kenyan wildlife preserve, Tina (Pamela Franklin) is remarkably at home with the resident animals. In fact, she is so comfortable with the various creatures that her best friend is an adult lion. While Tina isn't too worried by this relationship, her mother, Christine (Capucine), becomes extremely concerned, and requests that her ex-husband -- Tina's father, Robert (William Holden) -- come for a visit to help straighten the girl out. (Drama, Adventure) - 1962

bbcamerica.us.title: Jason Goes to Hell: The Final Friday
bbcamerica.us.description: After being blown away by a team of FBI agents, Jason Voorhees (Kane Hodder) needs to find a way to overcome certain death. When his bloodied remains are sent to the morgue, his heart, still intact, is able to hypnotize a coroner and take over his body. After brutally dispatching a couple of FBI agents, he heads back to his favorite stomping grounds: Crystal Lake. Jason commences another teen massacre while a bounty hunter (Steven Williams) discovers the only way to kill him. (Horror) - 1993

bbcamerica.us.title: Friday the 13th
bbcamerica.us.description: Against the advice of locals and police, Clay (Jared Padalecki) scours the eerie woods surrounding Crystal Lake for his missing sister. But the rotting cabins of an abandoned summer camp are not the only things he finds. Hockey-masked killer Jason Voorhees lies in wait for a chance to use his razor-sharp machete on Clay and the group of college students who have come to the forest to party. (Horror, Thriller) - 2009

bbcamerica.us.title: Friday the 13th
bbcamerica.us.description: Crystal Lake's history of murder doesn't deter counselors from setting up a summer camp in the woodsy area. Superstitious locals warn against it, but the fresh-faced young people -- Jack (Kevin Bacon), Alice (Adrienne King), Bill (Harry Crosby), Marcie (Jeannine Taylor) and Ned (Mark Nelson) -- pay little heed to the old-timers. Then they find themselves stalked by a brutal killer. As they're slashed, shot and stabbed, the counselors struggle to stay alive against a merciless opponent. (Horror) - 1980

bbcamerica.us.title: Friday the 13th, Part 2
bbcamerica.us.description: The second entry in the long-running horror series focuses on a group of teenage would-be counselors converging on Camp Crystal Lake for training under the tutelage of head counselor Paul (John Furey). Inevitably, Paul relates the story of Jason Voorhees (Warrington Gillette), a boy who ostensibly drowned at the camp and whose mother murdered a group of counselors in revenge. No one takes the tale seriously until a very much alive Jason begins gruesomely eliminating people. (Horror, Action, Mystery, Crime drama, Thriller) - 1981

bbcamerica.us.title: Freddy vs. Jason
bbcamerica.us.description: Two horror icons face off in this supernatural movie. Disfigured serial killer Freddy Krueger (Robert Englund), who attacks his victims in their dreams, has lost much of his power since citizens of his town have become less afraid of him. Enlisting the help of fellow violent murderer Jason Voorhees (Ken Kirzinger), Freddy orchestrates a new killing spree. However, when the hockey-mask-wearing psychopath won't stop chopping up Freddy's intended victims, the two ghouls start to battle each other. (Horror) - 2003

bbcamerica.us.title: Friday the 13th Part 3
bbcamerica.us.description: The third installment in the "Friday the 13th" series picks up on the day after the carnage with homicidal maniac Jason Voorhees (Richard Brooker) stealing some clothes and killing a local store owner. Meanwhile, Chris (Dana Kimmell) and her sometimes boyfriend, Rick (Paul Kratka), are hosting a group of teenage friends at Chris' lake house. Despite a run-in with a local biker gang, they enjoy an amiable weekend together -- that is, until Jason begins knocking off kids and bikers alike. (Horror, Action, Crime drama, Thriller, Mystery) - 1982

bbcamerica.us.title: Seven Worlds, One Planet - Europe
bbcamerica.us.description: High above the city of Gibraltar, Barbary macaques, Europe's only non-human primates, live lives full of kidnappings and high drama; in the cemeteries of Vienna Grave Robbing European hamsters do battle with each other for food. (Nature, Documentary) - 2019-11-24

bbcamerica.us.title: Hidden Habitats - Amazon
bbcamerica.us.description: The diversity of the Amazon and the strategies used by the jungle life to make the most of limited nutrients. (Nature, Documentary) - 2014-10-14

bbcamerica.us.title: Ghost Rider
bbcamerica.us.description: Years ago, motorcycle stuntman Johnny Blaze sold his soul to save the life of a loved one. Now, he transforms into a fiery, avenging agent of justice at night wherever evil roams. As the only one who can walk in both worlds, Johnny is charged by Mephistopheles himself to destroy Blackheart, a demon that wants to overthrow Mephistopheles and create a worse hell than the one that currently exists. (Action, Fantasy, Adventure, Thriller, Drama) - 2007

bbcamerica.us.title: Judge Dredd
bbcamerica.us.description: In the crime-plagued future, the only thing standing between order and chaos is Judge Joseph Dredd (Sylvester Stallone). His duty: police the violent metropolitan sprawls that crowd the decaying earth, and kill criminals on the spot if necessary. The tables are turned, however, when maniacal ex-Judge Rico (Armand Assante) frames Dredd for murder. But, as his opponents soon discover, not even a prison sentence can stop Dredd from doling out his signature brand of justice. (Action, Science fiction) - 1995

bbcamerica.us.description: Years after Tommy Jarvis (John Shepherd) murdered hockey-masked serial killer Jason Voorhees, he resides in a mental hospital and struggles with the trauma of the experience. With the help of his new friend, Willard Hewitt (Christopher Penn), and defiant teen Ariel Moore (Lori Singer), he might loosen up this conservative town. buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

buzzr.us.title: The Price Is Right
buzzr.us.description: "Come on down!" "The Price Is Right" -- hosted by Bob Barker until 2007 and Drew Carey thereafter -- features a wide variety of games and contests with the same basic challenge: Guess the prices of everyday (or not-quite-everyday) retail items. Four contestants, all of whom are seated in one of the wildest audiences in daytime game-show history, are called to the stage to play a preliminary pricing round. That winner joins the host on stage for one of more than 70 different pricing games. After three such games, the contestants spin a big wheel -- hoping to get as close to $1 as possible -- in the "Showcase Showdown." That's repeated in the second half of the show, and two highest winners of that round advance to the final, where prizes could be cars or roomsful of furniture. Models present the prizes. (Game show) - 1972-09-04

hgtvwest.us.title: Renovation Aloha
hgtvwest.us.description: S03 E12 Tristyn's Childhood Home Renovation When Kamohai and Tristyn rebuild her childhood home, the renovation becomes deeply personal; tight budgets, sky-high expectations, and family emotions collide, turning this project into their most meaningful and pressure-filled challenge yet.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S26 E07 Escaping the City to Live at the Beach A Long Island native who spent her life working in Manhattan is ready to fulfill her dream of moving permanently to the Hamptons; with the help of her best friend, she searches for a beach home in Hampton Bays, N.Y.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S29 E14 Making the Move From Renting to Buying in Myrtle Beach A busy couple head to Myrtle Beach, S.C., whenever they get a chance to escape; after 20 years of renting, they're ready to buy a home of their own where they can continue to make lasting memories together.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S28 E02 Third Time Is the Charm After losing out on two different houses in Ocean Isle, this couple is hoping that a third attempt will be their last so that they can enjoy the beach life with their two young children.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S29 E04 A Girls Getaway on Mobile Bay A woman and her daughter -- feeling outnumbered by the seven boys in their blended family -- are looking for a waterfront getaway in Mobile Bay, Ala.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S29 E13 Uncovering a Bargain Buried on Treasure Island A busy family is on the hunt for a waterfront getaway in Treasure Island, Fla., where they can spend more time with the kids; they want a fully furnished condo with a pool, but checking off their wish list for under $450,000 is challenging.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S29 E05 Leaving the Lagoon to Live Out a Beach Dream Globetrotters Anna and Geoff decide to put down roots in Placencia, Belize; they've been living along the lagoon side of the island with their two children, but they've always dreamed of moving to the beach.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S28 E04 Cashing in on the Caribbean's Best A couple make up for living in landlocked Missouri with frequent vacations to tropical destinations; after discovering the affordability of the Dominican Republic, they want to find a place of their own in the Caribbean's top tourist location.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S29 E06 The Keys to Unlocking a Deal Having fallen in love with the great fishing in the Florida Keys, Mike and Donna think it's the perfect vacation destination for them; hoping to use it as an investment, they are looking for their dream beach home right on the water.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S29 E02 Life Change in the Florida Keys A Colorado bachelor searches for a home near the sparkling blue waters of the Florida Keys, where he is set to take over a local fishing charter company.

hgtvwest.us.title: Beachfront Bargain Hunt
hgtvwest.us.description: S30 E01 Beach House Hopes for a First-Time Buyer A recent graduate relocated to North Carolina to live with her parents, but now she's squirreled enough money away to find a place of her own.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S274 E03 A Palatial Property in Tulum, Mexico A Dallas couple plans for the future when both their mothers will move in, and they're searching for a home for everyone in Tulum, Mexico; she wants something near the beach with at least five bedrooms, but he's more concerned about design details.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S273 E02 Choosing a Poolside Paradise in Costa Rica With three kids in college, a couple's ready to trade the ski hills of Colorado for warm weather in Tamarindo, Costa Rica; they have a long wish list, and she's determined to have a pool, but he's an avid surfer and prefers proximity to the beach.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: Sunsets and Sharks in Bimini, Bahamas A couple's ready to leave Chicago winters behind and find a paradise home in the Bahamas; they're looking for a place in Bimini with enough space to accommodate their two sons, but with limited inventory, finding the perfect place may be a challenge.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S274 E04 Going for Good Vibrations in Cabarete A couple looks to relocate from wet and chilly Seattle to the sunshine and warm weather of the Dominican Republic; they both want a modern esthetic with views right on the water, and he's open to renovations, but she insists on turnkey.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S273 E03 Ready to Roll Tide in Maui, Hawaii After years of hard work, a couple moves from Ala. to Roll Tide in Maui, Hawaii; they want ocean views and a fenced yard for their four dogs, but even with a hefty budget, finding the perfect place on this coveted coastline may be a challenge.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S271 E27 A Jewel in St. Thomas, USVI A family's ready to trade their St. Thomas condo for a paradise home with more privacy. She's looking for a turnkey property with a pool and more space for the kids, but he's more focused on a modern, cliffside home with amazing views.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters ᴺᵉʷ
hgtvwest.us.description: S279 E13 Gotta Find Peace of Mind After seeing 40 properties with no success, a couple can't come to terms on what to buy in Atlanta. One wants a vintage charmer and doesn't mind projects, but the other's only ever rented, and he's insisting on a move-in ready condo with an HOA.

hgtvwest.us.description: S275 E01 Analyze This! A couple is adopting a child, so they need to find a bigger home in the New Jersey suburbs; one wants an all-new house to go with their all-new family, but the other's using therapy techniques to try to get them in something historic.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S271 E28 Hobby Farm in Saginaw After several moves for his military career, a couple is ready to settle down with their daughters in Saginaw, Michigan. He wants a move-in ready home with land for a hobby farm, but she's set on a spacious fixer.

hgtvwest.us.description: S277 E01 Twins Reunite in Dallas Identical twins and their husbands have a complicated home search near Dallas. The twins are finally reuniting after 40 years apart, but opinions are divided on whether to buy adjoining properties or if they should all live under one roof.

hgtvwest.us.title: House Hunters
hgtvwest.us.description: S274 E07 You're Out of Your Mind A family in Ohio looks to live their best life and relocate to Hilton Head, South Carolina; they've got just one weekend to find a home and he wants a fixer, but after a lifetime of living in construction zones, she's not giving up on something new.

hgtvwest.us.description: S274 E10 Buy Me Maybe A couple living in a small NYC apartment looks for more space in Wilmington, Del.; she has nine months left to finish a dental residency, and he thinks it's too soon to buy, but she may be ready to pull the trigger if they find the right charmer.

hgtvwest.us.description: S273 E14 No Radiators for Baby An expectant couple has seen over 50 houses, and they're still reluctant to commit to anything less than the perfect place in New Jersey; she's ready to make sacrifices to be settled before the birth, but he's finding flaws in every home they see.

hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E03 Welcome to the Doll House Miniatures and dioramas have overrun the second floor of a woman's home; as a cancer survivor, she's enlisting Bobby's design help to transform her upstairs back into a place she can spend time with her grandkids.

hgtvwest.us.title: Junk or Jackpot?
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E02 Game Over-Haul A couple's home is overflowing with their collections, and now that their son is growing up, they want to be better role models. They enlist Bobby to design a space for family, and they're selling some of their prized collections to help pay for it.

hgtvwest.us.title: Junk or Jackpot?
hgtvwest.us.description: S01 E01 It's a Doll World After All A puppet collector enlists Bobby's help to transform his condo into a home that will welcome back his partner while also honoring his collection.

hgtvwest.us.description: S07 E06 Sometimes Size Matters Teams kick off Week Six by heading outside to renovate their backyards; with a spin of the roulette wheel, each wins a swimming pool to create their own Vegas oasis; former NFL great Danny Amendola arrives to determine who made the right moves.

hgtvwest.us.title: Rock the Block
hgtvwest.us.description: S07 E07 Let's Win This It's the Final Week, and the teams must finish their home exteriors as they try to add every dollar to their final appraisal; property Brothers Jonathan and Drew Scott arrive to assess the finished homes and crown a new winner!

hgtvwest.us.title: Fixer to Fabulous

hgtvwest.us.title: Fixer to Fabulous
hgtvwest.us.description: S05 E08 Lakeside House in the Trees A couple and their young daughter are ready to update their midcentury three-story house on the lake. hgtvwest.us.title: Fixer to Fabulous
hgtvwest.us.description: S07 E10 Fix This Scullery Shuffle The Marrs take on a renovation for a gardening enthusiast, creating both a modern main kitchen and a scullery for canning veggies from her garden; unexpected challenges push the budget, and the Marrs' kids get a special surprise at home.

hgtvwest.us.title: Fixer to Fabulous

justicecentral.us.description: Judge Glenda Hatchett presided over her self-titled courtroom show from 2000-2008. Now, she returns to the medium with "The Verdict." In the half-hour series, the Atlanta native and former juvenile-court judge rules over small-claims cases brought in front of her. Hatchett's courtroom isn't just about finding someone guilty, though. She also uses her experience dealing with young people and her tough-love approach to help send a message to out-of-control juvenile offenders to try to set them on the right track in their lives. 365blk.us.title: B.A.P.S
365blk.us.description: Waitresses at a Georgia restaurant, Nisi and Mickey, decide to fly to Los Angeles for a music-video audition in order to raise money for their dream project, a business that combines soul-food dining with a hair salon. Circumstances eventually find the Southern ladies on the estate of Mr. Blakemore, an elderly millionaire. Despite their vast cultural differences, Nisi and Mickey form close bonds with Blakemore and his butler. (Comedy) - 1997

365blk.us.title: Soul Men
365blk.us.description: Louis (Samuel L. Jackson) and Floyd (Bernie Mac) used to be one of the country's top musical duos, until they broke up and never spoke again. Old animosities resurface 20 years later when the two are thrust together on a cross-country trip to take part in a tribute concert honoring their late band leader. Louis and Floyd have just five short days to bury the hatchet -- hopefully not in someone's head -- before they take the stage at New York's Apollo Theater. (Comedy) - 2008

365blk.us.title: Why Do Fools Fall in Love
365blk.us.description: In 1956, Frankie Lymon and the Teenagers landed a doo-wop hit with Why Do Fools Fall in Love? Fame turned to tragedy as lead singer Lymon (Larenz Tate) descended into substance abuse that eventually claimed his life at age 25. But Lymon didn't just leave his fans bereft -- he also left behind three women, and each believes she's owed his song royalties: Platters singer Zola Taylor (Halle Berry), prostitute Elizabeth Waters (Vivica A. Fox) and schoolteacher Emira Eagle (Lela Rochon). (Biography) - 1998

365blk.us.title: Tyler Perry's Temptation: Confessions of a Marriage Counselor
365blk.us.description: Judith (Jurnee Smollett-Bell) has known her husband, Brice (Lance Gross), since they were in high school, but now their marriage is growing stale. Having just completed her graduate work in psychotherapy, she's eager to begin a career as a marriage counselor. She takes an internship at a matchmaking firm for millionaires and meets Harley (Robbie Jones), a charismatic client who makes no effort to hide his attraction to Judith. Judith succumbs to his charms, placing her marriage in jeopardy. (Drama, Romance, Thriller) - 2013

365blk.us.title: Collateral Beauty
365blk.us.description: When a successful New York advertising executive (Will Smith) suffers a great tragedy, he retreats from life. While his concerned friends try desperately to reconnect with him, he seeks answers from the universe by writing letters to Love, Time and Death. When his notes bring unexpected personal responses, he begins to understand how these constants interlock in a life fully lived and how even the deepest loss can reveal moments of meaning and beauty. (Drama, Fantasy) - 2016

365blk.us.title: Hurricane Smith

365blk.us.title: The Parent 'Hood - Goodfella
365blk.us.description: After witnessing a crime, Wendell (Faizon Love) wavers on reporting it to the police for fear of retaliation. With Robert Townsend and Curtis Williams Jr. (Sitcom) - 1996-11-17

365blk.us.title: The Parent 'Hood - The Parade-y Bunch
365blk.us.description: Camping out on the street for a parade gives the Petersons new insight into the lives of the homeless. (Holiday, Sitcom) - 1996-11-24

365blk.us.title: The Parent 'Hood - Baby Oprah

365blk.us.title: Roc - Joey's First Fan
365blk.us.description: Roc (Charles Dutton) suspects the motives of a young man who flatters Joey (Rocky Carroll) by admiring his trumpet playing. (Sitcom) - 1992-12-13

365blk.us.title: Law Abiding Citizen
365blk.us.description: Clyde Shelton is an honorable family man, until the day his wife and daughter are murdered in a home invasion. He hopes for justice, but a rising prosecutor named Nick Rice cuts a deal with one of the killers in exchange for testimony. Ten years later, that man is found dead. (Thriller, Crime drama) - 2009

5starmax.us.title: The Hangover Part II
5starmax.us.description: Two years after the disastrous events in Las Vegas, it is now Stu's (Ed Helms) turn to walk down the aisle. Since his bride is from Thailand, Stu decides to hold the wedding there. Desperately hoping to avoid the mayhem of Doug's (Justin Bartha) bachelor party, Stu chooses what he thinks will be a safe option: an alcohol-free, pre-wedding brunch. But this being Thailand, and with Phil (Bradley Cooper) and Alan (Zach Galifianakis) again in attendance, anything can happen. (Comedy) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Despicable Me
5starmax.us.description: Supervillain Gru, a man who delights in all things wicked, hatches a plan to steal the moon. Surrounded by an army of little yellow minions and his impenetrable arsenal of weapons and war machines, Gru prepares to vanquish all who stand in his way. However, nothing in his calculations and groundwork has prepared him for his greatest challenge: three adorable orphan girls who want to make him their dad. (Animated, Children, Comedy, Adventure) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Batman
5starmax.us.description: Having witnessed his parents' brutal murder as a child, millionaire philanthropist Bruce Wayne (Michael Keaton) fights crime in Gotham City disguised as Batman, a costumed hero who strikes fear into the hearts of villains. But when a deformed madman who calls himself The Joker (Jack Nicholson) seizes control of Gotham's criminal underworld, Batman must face his most ruthless nemesis ever while protecting both his identity and his love interest, reporter Vicki Vale (Kim Basinger). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1989

5starmax.us.title: Batman Returns
5starmax.us.description: The monstrous Penguin (Danny DeVito), who lives in the sewers beneath Gotham, joins up with wicked shock-headed businessman Max Shreck (Christopher Walken) to topple the Batman (Michael Keaton) once and for all. But when Shreck's timid assistant, Selina Kyle (Michelle Pfeiffer), finds out, and Shreck tries to kill her, she is transformed into the sexy Catwoman. She teams up with the Penguin and Shreck to destroy Batman, but sparks fly unexpectedly when she confronts the caped crusader. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1992

5starmax.us.title: Batman Forever
5starmax.us.description: Batman (Val Kilmer) faces off against two foes: the schizophrenic, horribly scarred former District Attorney Harvey Dent, aka Two-Face (Tommy Lee Jones), and the Riddler (Jim Carrey), a disgruntled ex-Wayne Enterprises inventor seeking revenge against his former employer by unleashing his brain-sucking weapon on Gotham City's residents. As the caped crusader also deals with tortured memories of his parents' murder, he has a new romance, with psychologist Chase Meridian (Nicole Kidman). (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1995

5starmax.us.title: Batman & Robin
5starmax.us.description: This superhero adventure finds Batman (George Clooney) and his partner, Robin (Chris O'Donnell), attempting to the foil the sinister schemes of a deranged set of new villains, most notably the melancholy Mr. Freeze (Arnold Schwarzenegger), who wants to make Gotham into an arctic region, and the sultry Poison Ivy (Uma Thurman), a plant-loving femme fatale. As the Dynamic Duo contends with these bad guys, a third hero, Batgirl (Alicia Silverstone), joins the ranks of the city's crime-fighters. (Action, Adventure, Fantasy) - 1997

5starmax.us.title: Godzilla Raids Again
5starmax.us.description: Prehistoric monsters Godzilla and Anguirus battle it out in Osaka, Japan. (Science fiction) - 1955

5starmax.us.title: Sweet Dreams
5starmax.us.description: Aspiring country singer Patsy Cline (Jessica Lange) is resigned to both her thankless gigs and her unhappy marriage, until she meets the charismatic Charlie Dick (Ed Harris). Eventually leaving her husband to marry Charlie, Patsy temporarily shelves her performing career to be a mother. Later she returns to singing and finds success under manager Randy Hughes (David Clennon). Patsy hits a remarkable stride with a string of hit singles, and has become a full-fledged star when tragedy strikes. (Biography) - 1985

5starmax.us.title: Nanny McPhee Returns
5starmax.us.description: Enigmatic Nanny McPhee arrives on the doorstep of a harried mother, Isabel Green, who is trying to raise her kids and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war. Isabel has her hands full of not only her own three, but also with her sister's spoiled pair. With no time to lose, McPhee uses magic to instill in the children five important lessons. (Children, Comedy, Fantasy) - 2010

5starmax.us.title: Hop
5starmax.us.description: Beneath Easter Island, in a giant factory that manufactures the world's Easter candy, the popular rabbit is preparing to pass the mantle to his son, E.B. (Russell Brand). But E.B. has no interest in the job and would rather be a drummer. He runs away to Los Angeles, where an unemployed slacker named Fred O'Hare (James Marsden) accidentally runs into him. Feigning injury, E.B. tricks Fred into giving him shelter, but an oversized chick is planning a coup back on Easter Island. (Family, Holiday, Comedy, Animated) - 2011

5starmax.us.title: Dr. Seuss' Horton Hears a Who!
5starmax.us.description: Animated elephant Horton finds a speck of dust floating in the Jungle of Nool. Upon investigation of the speck, Horton discovers the tiny city of Whoville and its residents, the Whos, which he can hear but cannot see. Horton forms a friendship with the mayor of Whoville, Ned McDodd, and promises to transport Whoville to safety. However, Horton encounters opposition from his jungle neighbors, who don't want to believe in the existence of Whoville. (Animated, Children, Adventure) - 2008

5starmax.us.title: Little Shop of Horrors
5starmax.us.description: Meek flower shop assistant Seymour (Rick Moranis) pines for co-worker Audrey (Ellen Greene). During a total eclipse, he discovers an unusual plant he names Audrey II, which feeds only on human flesh and blood. The growing plant attracts a great deal of business for the previously struggling store. After Seymour feeds Audrey's boyfriend, Orin (Steve Martin), to the plant after Orin's accidental death, he must come up with more bodies for the increasingly bloodthirsty plant. (Musical comedy) - 1986

backstage.us.description: At the forefront of early hip-hop culture, DJ Kenny Kirkland (Guy Davis), his B-boy brother, Lee (Robert Taylor), and graffiti artist Ramon (John Chardiet) all have hopes of showcasing their talents outside the confines of South Bronx, N.Y. When a student writes the police code for homicide, 187, inside a textbook owned by teacher Trevor Garfield (Samuel L. Jackson), he feels threatened. The principal dismisses the incident, but, soon after, Trevor is stabbed by the same student. Fifteen months later, a physically and emotionally scarred Trevor relocates to California and takes up substitute teaching. To his dismay, his new school is as full of dangerously undisciplined students as the last one, driving Trevor over the edge. (Drama) - 1997

backstage.us.title: Belly
backstage.us.description: Ever since they were kids, Sincere (Nas) and Buns (DMX) have lived life close to the edge, doing whatever it takes to survive. As adults, they build up their kingdom of crime on drug dealing and robbery. But Sincere grows weary of the criminal lifestyle and joins a black Muslim religious group. Buns, on the other hand, sinks deeper into criminality and faces serious prison time. The cops offer him a deal, however -- assassinate the head of the Muslim group, and he will go free. (Crime drama, Thriller, Music) - 1998

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - An Officer's Wife
dateline.us.description: Secrets emerge, and a family is torn apart when a cop's wife is shot to death in her bed.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Hands of a Killer
dateline.us.description: When former Sen. Linda Collins of Arkansas is found fatally stabbed outside her home, detectives investigate if her murder is connected to her political career or her personal life; the victim's children speak out about the case.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Sleepover
dateline.us.description: A devoted mother is found shot to death in her minivan; the case stays cold until old memories resurface and new revelations come to light, dividing her Florida family.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - Bethany Vanished

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - At the Edge of Town
dateline.us.description: When a college student is found dead after a party, his mother gets the help of a new friend to get the case in front of a jury.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - The Grudge
dateline.us.description: The deadly 2020 shooting at U.S. District Court Judge Esther Salas' home, which killed her son and critically injured her husband.

dateline.us.title: Dateline NBC - A Girl Named Egypt

circlecountry.us.title: Red Headed Stranger
circlecountry.us.description: The Rev. Shay moves out West to set up his new home in Montana so that he can spread God's word. But when his wife, Raysha, leaves him for another man -- in part because she wants to return to Philadelphia -- the reverend decides to replace his spiritual ways with a gun. After shooting down his wife and her lover, he battles a landowner intent on keeping all the town's water for himself. But his deadly ways make him yearn for a belief in God again. (Western) - 1986

circlecountry.us.title: Barbarosa
circlecountry.us.description: In pre-Civil War Texas, naïve Karl Westover (Gary Busey) accidentally kills his brother-in-law, and heads to Mexico to escape the consequences. Along the way, he encounters Barbarosa (Willie Nelson), who is also on the run. Barbarosa teaches Karl survival skills for the desert — and how to rob. In their journey from Texas to Mexico and back again, the two men are captured by outlaw Angel Morales, and pursued by Don Braulio (Gilbert Roland), who wants Barbarosa dead. (Western, Comedy drama, Romance) - 1982

circlecountry.us.title: The Undefeated
circlecountry.us.description: Unaware that the Civil War has ended, Col. John Henry Thomas (John Wayne) successfully attacks a Confederate company led by James Langdon (Rock Hudson). With the remnants of Langdon's squadron fleeing to Mexico, Thomas and his adopted Native American son, Blue Boy (Roman Gabriel), gather a herd of horses and head for the border with their company, to sell them. After Langdon's caravan is captured by a Mexican general (Tony Aguilar), Thomas nobly sacrifices the horses to free them. (Western) - 1969

circlecountry.us.title: The Shooting
circlecountry.us.description: In the American West, Willet Gashade (Warren Oates), a former bounty hunter, and Coley Boyard (Will Hutchins), his dimwitted partner, are approached by a secretive young woman (Millie Perkins) who offers them money to guide her through the desert but refuses to discuss why she is traveling. The group embarks on the journey and is eventually joined by Billy Spear (Jack Nicholson), a volatile gunslinger the woman has also hired. The only question is why. (Western) - 1967

circlecountry.us.title: The Deadly Companions
circlecountry.us.description: When a bank heist goes wrong, outlaw Yellowleg (Brian Keith) inadvertently kills a 9-year-old boy -- the son of saloon girl Kit Tildon (Maureen O'Hara). Plagued by guilt over the shooting, Yellowleg vows to help her bury the boy beside his father in the now-derelict town of Siringo, Ariz. With criminal cohorts Billy (Steve Cochran) and Turk (Chill Wills), Yellowleg embarks on a dangerous journey into Apache territory to lay the boy in his final resting place. (Western) - 1962

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Contract
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Frank Carden (Morgan Freeman), one of the world's greatest assassins, is handed a lucrative contract to kill a highly secretive billionaire. But in a twist of fate, Carden is involved in a car accident during the job, and when his gun is found after he is admitted to a hospital, federal marshals arrest him. Meanwhile, ex-cop Ray Keene (John Cusack) is hiking with his son, Chris (Jamie Anderson), when Carden's cohorts try to spring him from custody, and soon the pair is caught in the crossfire. (Thriller) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Heathers
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty). (Dark comedy, Crime drama) - 1989

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: My Mom's New Boyfriend
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: After several years away, FBI agent Henry Durand (Colin Hanks) returns to find his mother, Marty (Meg Ryan), a much different person: Having long mourned for Henry's father, she is now embracing single life. One day, while Marty, Henry and his new fiancée, Emily (Selma Blair), are out for a walk, they meet Tommy (Antonio Banderas), a mysterious stranger, with whom Marty then becomes involved. However, through his FBI contacts, Henry learns that Tommy is suspected of being an art thief. (Romantic comedy, Comedy, Crime drama, Romance) - 2008

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Eye See You
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one. (Thriller) - 2002

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Direct Contact
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given the chance for freedom if he is able to rescue a kidnapped American woman. (Action) - 2009

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: The Long Walk Home
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better. (Historical drama) - 1990

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Honest Thief
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Hoping to cut a deal, a professional bank robber agrees to return all the money he stole in exchange for a reduced sentence. But when two FBI agents set him up for murder, he must now go on the run to clear his name and bring them to justice. (Action, Thriller) - 2020

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Animal Factory
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid. (Drama, Crime drama) - 2000

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gang of Roses
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew. (Western, Action) - 2003

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: 10th and Wolf
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them. (Drama) - 2006

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Gerry
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Friends Gerry (Casey Affleck) and Gerry (Matt Damon) hike into Death Valley, but they stray so far from the trail that they have no idea how to get back. Initially, they maintain morale by rehashing old stories and reciting inside jokes, but the gravity of their situation sinks in as a return to civilization becomes more unlikely. As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed. (Drama) - 2002

filmrisefreemovies.us.title: Just Getting Started
filmrisefreemovies.us.description: Duke Diver is living the high life as the freewheeling manager of a luxurious resort in Palm Springs, Calif. He soon faces competition from Leo, a former military man who likes the same woman that Duke is interested in. When Diver's past suddenly catches up with him, he must put aside his differences and reluctantly team up with Leo to stop whoever is trying to kill him. (Holiday, Comedy) - 2017

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Hip Hop Homicides
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E05 Soulja Slim Van delves into the mystery of the murder of New Orleans legend and "No Limit" rap star, Soulja Slim.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Hip Hop Homicides
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E06 XXXTentacion Young rap star XXXTentacion's life was cut tragically short when he was shot dead in the parking lot of a motorsports store near his home in Florida; this could have just been a robbery gone wrong, but XXXTentacion may have predicted his own murder.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Hip Hop Homicides
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E07 MO3 Van Lathan investigates the brazen highway shooting of Dallas rapper Mo3; was up-and-coming Dallas rapper Mo3's murder a crime of passion?

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Hip Hop Homicides
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E08 FBG Duck FBG Duck has helped to define the signature sound of Chicago Drill Music, only to be gunned down in a mob-style hit; exploring if he was murdered because of his street ties, music or where he was from in Chicago.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Six Minutes to Midnight
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: With Germany and the United Kingdom on the brink of war, an undercover British agent poses as a teacher at a finishing school for daughters of high-ranking Nazis.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Winnie Mandela
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: The story of South African politician Winnie Mandela (Jennifer Hudson).

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S03 E01 Sequels That Don't Suck Fans of horror films, like "A Nightmare on Elm Street 3," "Psycho II," "The First Purge," "Bride of Chucky," "Scream 2" and "Gremlins 2: The New Batch," sometimes say sequels are as good or even better than the originals.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S03 E02 Infections Horror has warned about pandemics for years, in films that mirror reality, such as "Outbreak," "Contagion," "12 Monkeys," surreal plagues "Shivers," "Rabid," zombie outbreaks "REC," "Pontypool" and pathogens from space "The Andromeda Strain."

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S03 E03 Psychics In films like "The Dead Zone," "Scanners," "Doctor Sleep" and "Beetlejuice," horror superstars Stephen King, David Cronenberg, Mike Flanagan, Brian DePalma, Sam Raimi, Peter Jackson and Tim Burton bring psychic powers to the screen in thrilling ways.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: The J-Horror Virus
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: Charting the origins of a new strain of supernatural horror which emerged in Japan at the turn of the millennium and went on to take over the world.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S03 E04 Apocalyptic Horror The apocalyptic visions of "World War Z," "Train to Busan," "Zombieland," "War of the Worlds," "I Am Legend," "The Omega Man," "10 Cloverfield Lane," "Night of the Comet" and "The Invasion of the Body Snatchers."

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S03 E05 Holiday Horror Holiday mayhem, including "Black Christmas," "Krampus," "Silent Night Deadly Night," "Terror Train," "My Bloody Valentine," "Mother's Day," "April Fool's Day," "Happy Death Day" and the 2018 "Halloween," featuring returning guest Jamie Lee Curtis.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Eli Roth's History of Horror
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S03 E06 Mad Scientist From Frankenstein to Frank N. Furter, mad scientists smash the barriers of polite society; featuring "Frankenstein," "Ex Machina," "The Invisible Man," "The Fly," "Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde," "Altered States" and "The Rocky Horror Picture Show."

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Cursed Films
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E01 The Exorcist The release of "The Exorcist" is surrounded by controversy, as reports of fainting theater-goers and mysterious on-set accidents raise questions whether the film itself is evil.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: Cursed Films
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E03 The Omen A series of unfortunate events plague the cast and crew during the making of "The Omen," raising concerns that the film might be cursed by the devil himself.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E01 Absorb Attention At North Port High School in Florida, three students die within months of each other; as the community learns more, they discover a common thread: all three students were hypnotized by their principal, Dr. George Kenney, not long before they died.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E02 Bypass the Critical Dr. George Kenney begins to reveal his side of the story; as details emerge about the deaths and Marcus, Wesley and Brittany's parents speak out, an investigation into Kenney's hypnosis practice begins; the North Port community grows suspicious.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E03 Activate the Unconscious The press catches wind of the story, and it captures headlines worldwide; Dr. Kenney is asked to leave North Port High, and as the criminal trial heats up, the community is split on his culpability; a student comes forward with a new perspective.

ifcfilmspicks.us.title: True Crime Story: Look Into My Eyes
ifcfilmspicks.us.description: S01 E04 The Outcome Pressure mounts against the school board to take accountability; Dr. Kenney leaves North Port for what seems like the final time; the community grapples with guilt and grief; Stephen offers an intimate look into Kenney's hypnosis practice.

maverickblackcinema.us.title: How Did We Get Here
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Four struggling couples attend a wellness retreat led by Dr. Sellers. Melonie and Derrick struggle with issues of infidelity. (Drama) - 2025

maverickblackcinema.us.title: One More Day
maverickblackcinema.us.description: A single mother and her 15-year-old daughter's relationship is strained as the mother's career grows. (Drama) - 2022

maverickblackcinema.us.title: My Plus Size Bachelorette
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Symone, a spirited and vibrant plus-size woman in her 30s, finds herself navigating the unpredictable world of modern dating while grappling with the emotional aftermath of her one-night stand with Andre, her high school sweetheart. With her friends rallying around her, they encourage Symone to embrace her single status and embark on a journey of self-discovery and love. (Comedy, Drama, Romance) - 2025

maverickblackcinema.us.title: The Barista
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Brandon is a rising star in the podcast world. When he receives an on-air call from Paulette, a local barista, he soon learns that success comes at a price, as Paulette works to interject herself into an every aspect of his life, and sabotages his success in the process in her ultimate goal to be his number one in all aspects of his life. (Thriller) - 2025

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Kill for You
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Suga, a devoted mother, finds herself opening up to love again when she begins a relationship with Danny, a man who seems genuine and caring. But their connection is quickly tested when she is introduced to Danny's father, Rusty—a man whose deeply rooted racism creates an undercurrent of tension that can't be ignored. As Suga tries to navigate the relationship while protecting her son, she begins to sense that something isn't right beneath the surface. (Drama) - 2026

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Unintended Consequences
maverickblackcinema.us.description: A self-absorbed and ill-equipped father struggles to reconnect with his estranged and embittered son following his discovery of his affair with another woman. Wanting to defend his mother's honor, his son decides to seek revenge on the mistress. (Drama) - 2025

maverickblackcinema.us.title: The Laundry Room Stalker
maverickblackcinema.us.description: A string of murders targeting local neighborhood sex workers centers around one apartment building's laundry room. Suspicion quickly falls on Calvin, the newly hired attendant who was just released after serving 12 years in prison. But this building holds a thousand secrets, and as tensions rise, the truth will unravel. Who is the real killer? (Thriller) - 2025

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Game of Cards
maverickblackcinema.us.description: When data analyst Nicole Tucker's car is broken into and a mysterious military-issued card tied to her family legacy is stolen, she's thrust into a dangerous game of betrayal. Her search for the truth uncovers a chilling connection between the theft and her boyfriend Michael, forcing Nicole to confront dark secrets, deadly allies and a past that refuses to stay buried. (Action, Crime drama, Drama) - 2025

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Bottle Girl
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Diamond's dream of going to college is threatened by financial hardship. A desperate job at a glamorous Atlanta lounge exposes her to a world of temptation and danger. (Drama) - 2025

maverickblackcinema.us.title: I Hate I Love You
maverickblackcinema.us.description: A successful power couple is tested by betrayal and illegal activity. Both love and business face being destroyed. (Drama) - 2024

maverickblackcinema.us.title: Intrigue
maverickblackcinema.us.description: Jessica and Darren's marriage has hit a rocky stage in their lives. When a mysterious man named Michael enters her life, Jessica is intrigued explores options that could have deadly consequences. (Drama, Romance) - 2023

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: At Close Range
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: A farm boy (Sean Penn) looking for excitement finds himself on a collision course with his smooth-talking gang leader father (Christopher Walken) in this "powerfully disturbing" (Newsweek) tale based on the story of real-life killer Bruce Johnston.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: State Of Grace
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: An undercover cop (Sean Penn) comes back to his old neighborhood in Hell's Kitchen to bring down the Irish Mafia.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: 52 Pick-Up
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: In this tense thriller, Roy Scheider has it all until a trio of pornographers shows up with a video of him in bed with his mistress. When he tries to pit one blackmailer against the other, the tension mounts - as does the possibility of murder.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: No Man's Land (1987)
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: When a rookie cop goes undercover at a Porsche garage doubling as a chop shop, the fast cars and wild parties have him thinking that his suspect has the life he wants. But there may be more going on than just car theft...and he may be in too deep!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Navy Seals
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Charlie Sheen, Michael Biehn and Bill Paxton are three of America's finest Navy commandos. Sent to rescue the crew of a U.S. aircraft carrying Stinger missiles seized by Mideast terrorists, they're thrust onto the frontline of an explosive conflict!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Missing In Action
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: American servicemen are still being held captive in Vietnam – and it's up to one man to bring them home in this blistering, fast-paced action/adventure starring martial arts superstar Chuck Norris.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Missing In Action 2: The Beginning
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: Chuck Norris returns as James Braddock in this action-packed prequel to the original hit film. As war rages in Vietnam, Braddock and his men are captured and imprisoned. With fists and sheer courage, he must become an army of one to save his men.

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Braddock: Missing In Action III
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: When Colonel James Braddock (Chuck Norris, "Missing in Action") is told that his wife and 12-year-old son are still alive in Communist Vietnam, he mounts a one-man assault to free them…armed with the latest high-tech firepower, of course!

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Red Corner
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: In this provocative thriller, an American (Richard Gere) on a business trip in China is framed for a brutal murder and soon finds himself at the mercy of a foreign court system he doesn't understand. Can he find the true killer before it's too late?

mgmpresentsaction.us.title: Anti-Trust
mgmpresentsaction.us.description: In this sizzling, fast-paced thriller, computer whiz Milo Hoffman (Ryan Phillippe) lands his dream job at a major computer company, only to learn that the C.E.O. (Tim Robbins) may employ some very unorthodox -- and very deadly --business practices.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Tentacles
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: It's angry, hungry, well-armed and ready to sample the local cuisine! John Huston, Shelley Winters and Henry Fonda star in this gripping thriller!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Night Of The Comet
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: In this cult-classic zom-com, two totally awesome Valley Girls (Catherine Mary Stewart, Kelli Maroney) kick some zombie butt and go on the lam from bloodthirsty scientists after a passing comet turns all of Los Angeles into the walking undead!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Monkey Shines: An Experiment In Fear
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: In this classic spine-tingler, a paralyzed man (Jason Beghe) is cared for by Ella, an intelligent monkey. But when Ella seems to begin reading Allan's darker thoughts, he must stop the cunning maniacal creature...before she takes over his mind!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Believers
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Widowed police psychologist Cal Jamison (Martin Sheen) is forced to deal with a series of ritualistic child murders perpetrated by a rogue cult.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Clive Barker's Lord Of Illusions
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Scott Bakula stars as a detective who gets more than he bargains for in this thriller that rips apart the boundaries between the illusion and magic.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: From Beyond
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Humans are such easy prey! H.P. Lovecraft's classic tale of suspense becomes "a grisly amalgam of sex, shock and satire" (Newsweek) in the hands of the creators of "Re-Animator." Jeffrey Combs and Barbara Crampton star in this cult-classic!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Curse
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: When a ice-blue meteor plunges through the sky and lands on a dairy farm, every living thing is infected and the farm owners change…hideously!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Die, Monster, Die!
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: An English scientist entertains a young American visitor, serving up tea, terror and a beautiful daughter who is soon torn between her father's evil ways and protecting the man she loves. Boris Karloff stars in this H.P. Lovecraft adaptation.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Dunwich Horror
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: When a beautiful student named Nancy Wagner (Sandra Dee) catches the eye of the weird Wilbur Whateley (Dean Stockwell), her professor uncovers a buried secret and a plot intended to call forth an evil beyond imagination. Daniel Haller directs.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: Murders In The Rue Morgue
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: In Paris, a theatrical company with a specialty in Grand Guignol undertakes their most gruesome production yet! And the blood will flow!

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Hound Of The Baskervilles (1959)
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: A hellish hound feeds upon the flesh of the heirs of Baskerville Hall. But before this beast can sink its teeth into the newest lord, it must pit its vicious fangs against the searing intellect of Sherlock Holmes (Peter Cushing) and Dr. Watson.

mgmpresentshorror.us.title: The Last Man On Earth
mgmpresentshorror.us.description: Horror legend Vincent Price plays the sole survivor of a plague that turns humans into vampire-like zombies...and his life into an endless nightmare!

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Return of the Seven
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: The man in black (Yul Brynner) forms a new Magnificent Seven, to save Mexican farmers from slave labor.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Guns of the Magnificent Seven
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A mercenary (George Kennedy) recruits a knife man (James Whitmore), a gunman (Monte Markham) and four outlaws to free a Mexican patriot from prison.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Magnificent Seven Ride!
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A marshal (Lee Van Cleef), an Eastern reporter and five ex-convicts rescue widows from Mexican bandits.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Death Rides a Horse
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A young man (John Phillip Law) hunts his parents' killers with a veteran gunfighter (Lee Van Cleef) who has something to hide.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Ned Kelly
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: An Irish settler (Mick Jagger) and his brothers turn outlaw after their mother's arrest in frontier Australia.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Quigley Down Under
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: An Old West sharpshooter goes to Australia, where his new boss expects him to kill Aboriginal Australians.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: The Claim
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: Twenty years after a town's founder (Peter Mullan) trades his wife and daughter for a gold claim, the two arrive in his town.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Fort Bowie
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A cavalry captain's (Ben Johnson) colonel (Kent Taylor) sends him on a suicide mission in Apache country.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Terror in a Texas Town
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: George Hansen returns to his Texas hometown after 20 years at sea, and learns that his father was murdered two days prior. George discovers that an oil speculator had his father killed for refusing to sell his land at an unfair price.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Man From Del Rio
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A lawless frontier town, plagued by bandits, hires a notorious Mexican gunfighter to serve as its new sheriff.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Gun the Man Down
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: An outlaw is left by his cohorts and girlfriend to be captured after he is wounded during a heist. When he is released from prison, he tracks his old crew to a run-down town and plays a game of cat and mouse with them.

mgmpresentswesterns.us.title: Man With the Gun
mgmpresentswesterns.us.description: A hired gun (Robert Mitchum) saves a cow town from a land-grabber and wins back his wife (Jan Sterling).

moviesphere.us.description: Adam Lerner has always tried to take good care of his health, so it comes as a cruel surprise when he learns that he has malignant tumors along his spine; his doctor gives him a 50/50 chance of survival.

moviesphere.us.title: The DUFF
moviesphere.us.description: A high-school senior (Mae Whitman) sets out to reinvent herself and revolutionize the student body's social order after learning that a judgmental classmate has given her an embarrassing nickname.

moviesphere.us.title: The Edge of Seventeen
moviesphere.us.description: A high school junior (Hailee Steinfeld) develops an unexpected bond with a thoughtful teen (Hayden Szeto) after learning that her best friend (Haley Lu Richardson) is dating her older brother (Blake Jenner).

moviesphere.us.title: The Perks of Being a Wallflower
moviesphere.us.description: Socially awkward Charlie is a wallflower watching from the sidelines, until a pair of charismatic seniors take him under their wing.

moviesphere.us.title: Warm Bodies
moviesphere.us.description: After a highly unusual zombie saves a still-living girl from an attack, the two form a relationship that sets in motion events that might transform the entire lifeless world.

moviesphere.us.title: The Best Christmas Pageant Ever
moviesphere.us.description: The Herdmans are six siblings who have a reputation for being the worst kids in the world. However, when they take over the local church pageant during the holidays, they just might teach a shocked community the true meaning of Christmas.

moviesphere.us.title: The DUFF
moviesphere.us.description: A high-school senior (Mae Whitman) sets out to reinvent herself and revolutionize the student body's social order after learning that a judgmental classmate has given her an embarrassing nickname.

moviesphere.us.title: Southpaw
moviesphere.us.description: After losing everything to a senseless tragedy, a boxer (Jake Gyllenhaal) turns to a retired fighter (Forest Whitaker) for guidance as he struggles toward redemption.

moviesphere.us.title: Rumble Through the Dark
moviesphere.us.description: A desperate, bare-knuckle cage fighter battles to save his family home against the strongest of foes and the longest of odds.

moviesphere.us.title: Fall
moviesphere.us.description: Stranded 2,000 feet at the top of a remote, abandoned radio tower, two expert climbers are put to the ultimate test as they desperately fight to survive the elements, a lack of supplies, and vertigo-inducing heights.

hallmarkmovies&more.us.title: Good Witch
hallmarkmovies&more.us.description: Catherine Bell reprises her role of Cassie Nightingale in this series based on "The Good Witch" franchise of made-for-TV movies. Nightingale, the titular sorceress, embarks on a magical journey with teenage daughter Grace, who shares her mother's intuitive charm. When divorced Dr. Sam Radford and his teenage son move next door, they are quickly drawn to the Nightingales' unique prowess. Sam realizes that Cassie's signature charm is more than just a magic touch, ensuring the quaint town of Middleton is in for big surprises. (Drama, Romance) - 2015-02-28

outlaw.us.title: Riding Shotgun
outlaw.us.description: Larry Delong loses his sister and her son when they're gunned down by the notorious Dan Marady and his band of outlaws during a holdup. Delong takes a job as a stagecoach guard, hoping to run into the bandits and take revenge. Run into them, he does, but numbers are on Marady's side, and they shoot up and rob Delong's coach. Delong barely escapes with his life. When he tries to alert the authorities, they implicate him in the crime, and he becomes a fugitive. (Western) - 1954

outlaw.us.title: The Boy From Oklahoma
outlaw.us.description: An Old West law student (Will Rogers Jr.) turns unarmed sheriff, woos a girl (Nancy Olson) and lassos bad guys. (Western) - 1954

outlaw.us.title: How the West Was Won
outlaw.us.description: Setting off on a journey to the west in the 1830s, the Prescott family run into a man named Linus (James Stewart), who helps them fight off a pack of thieves. Linus then marries daughter Eve Prescott (Carroll Baker), and 30 years later goes off to fight in the Civil War with their son, with bloody results. Eve's sister, Lily (Debbie Reynolds), heads further west and has adventures with a professional gambler (Gregory Peck), stretching all the way to San Francisco and into the 1880s. (Western) - 1962

outlaw.us.title: Lone Star
outlaw.us.description: In the early 1840s, cattle baron Devereaux Burke (Clark Gable) is tasked by President Andrew Jackson (Lionel Barrymore) with an important diplomatic mission. Devereaux must convince soldier Sam Houston (Moroni Olsen) to help bring about the addition of Texas to the union. Along the way, Devereaux battles a pair of senators (Broderick Crawford, Ed Begley) who would rather create their own republic, and locks horns with a feisty newspaper reporter, Martha Ronda (Ava Gardner). (Western) - 1952

outlaw.us.title: Gun Glory
outlaw.us.description: Life is anything but sweet when roaming gunfighter Tom Early (Stewart Granger) returns home. His wife has died, and his son (Steve Rowland) now barely speaks to him. Things aren't much different in town, where Early tangles with the posse of a cattle baron (James Gregory) who vows to run a herd of 20,000 roughshod through the settlers' land. Early must somewhat reluctantly play the role of defender, especially after a foolhardy plan by the local preacher (Chill Wills) goes awry. (Western) - 1957

outlaw.us.title: The Lusty Men
outlaw.us.description: In the American West of the 1950s, talented rodeo rider Jeff McCloud quits after an injury. Returning to his hometown, he gets a job on a ranch. He strikes up a friendship with Wes, a fellow ranch hand who dreams of being a rodeo rider. Wes talks Jeff into training him, and joins the rodeo circuit with the reluctant approval of his wife. But when the two men start to disagree, Jeff returns to the circuit himself. (Western) - 1952

outlaw.us.title: Devil's Doorway
outlaw.us.description: Lance Poole (Robert Taylor) is a Native American who left his tribal homelands to fight for the Union in the Civil War. Despite earning the Congressional Medal of Honor for his heroic duties in the line of fire, when he returns home he's still faced with hatred and racism from the white community that neighbors his village. Unable to own property because he's not considered a citizen of the United States, he fights a lawyer's (Louis Calhern) attempts to take over his tribe's hard-earned land. (Western) - 1950

outlaw.us.title: The First Texan
outlaw.us.description: Having left his post as governor of Tennessee, Gen. Sam Houston (Joel McCrea) resettles in Mexican territory along the southwest U.S. border. He soon sets his sights on reclaiming the land under the aegis of Texas independence, while romancing post-divorce new love interest Katherine Delaney (Felicia Farr). His efforts eventually lead to the historic Battle of San Jacinto and a very clever bit of battlefield strategy by Houston in his fight against forces led by Gen. Santa Anna. (Western) - 1956

outlaw.us.title: The Sheepman
outlaw.us.description: Sheep farmer Jason Sweet (Glenn Ford) arrives in a small Western cattle town and promptly clashes with local tough guy Jumbo McCall (Mickey Shaughnessy). He also irks Stephen Bedford (Leslie Nielsen), a wealthy cattleman, with his advances toward Bedford's girlfriend, Dell Payton (Shirley MacLaine). With the entire town in an uproar over Sweet's behavior, Bedford arranges for Chocktaw Neal (Pernell Roberts), a seasoned gunslinger, to shoot him down. (Western, Comedy) - 1958

pickletv.us.description: S2025 E19 Live from Virginia Beach at the NCPA Virginia Regional 2025, the University of Virginia (UVA) faces off against High Point University in a crucial pool play match. With a bid to the National Championship in St. Louis on the line, these teams battle through a best-of-seven format.The episode kicks off with Women's Singles featuring Alexandra McDonald (UVA) and Sushi Bandaru (High Point), followed by an intense Men's Singles showdown between Eric Lee (UVA) and High Point's wild card, Freddy Ortmann. The action heats up in Men's Doubles with Cooper Duncan joining Ortmann, and Aiden Eggleston partnering with Lee. Watch for strategic mixed doubles play and see if High Point can force a sudden death dreambreaker.

pickletv.us.title: National Collegiate Pickleball Association (NCPA) : NCPA 2026 - Perseus vs. Hyperion Nationals
pickletv.us.description: S2026 E6 Experience the electrifying atmosphere of the Joola Showcase at the NCPA Nationals, where the top 12 collegiate athletes in America converge for a high-octane battle between Team Hyperion and Team Perseus. The match features a Racing pace with a unique sudden-death format that forces players to switch between singles, doubles, and mixed rounds every three points. Watch as these elite competitors demonstrate incredible Skills at the kitchen line, including precision dinks and aggressive "off the bounce" initiates that define modern collegiate play. In a Freestyle display of athleticism, stars like Jaden Broderick and Alexandra McDonald trade "exhibition-style" points in a quest to secure premium Yola paddles for their victory. This high-energy showdown serves as the ultimate prelude to Championship Sunday, proving that the future of pickleball is brighter than ever.

pickletv.us.description: S2 E1 The World Pickleball League returns for an explosive Season 2 at the iconic Jio World Garden in BKC, Mumbai. The season opener features a high-stakes rematch of last year's final: the defending champion Bengaluru Jawans, owned by cinematic powerhouse Atlee and Priya Atlee, take on the formidable Pune United, led by owner Riteish Deshmukh. Witness world-class athletes from 18 countries compete in a series of intense Men’s Singles, Women’s Doubles, and Mixed Doubles matches. With the pressure of a "Davis Cup" atmosphere and the precision of tactical "kitchen" play, both teams battle for every point to establish early dominance in India’s premier pickleball league.

pickletv.us.description: S2025 E15 Welcome to Week 3, Day 1 of the NCPA San Diego Regional 2025, live from the Barnes Tennis Center in the heart of San Diego, California. This highly anticipated state rivalry pits the UCLA Bruins against the SDSU Aztecs in a crucial best-of-seven collegiate team match.The match format prioritizes singles, with UCLA winning the coin toss and opting to start with Women's Singles. The broadcast features the Women's Singles match between Mae Lee (UCLA) and Emily Miller (SDSU), and the Men's Singles where SDSU's Preston Lynch takes a commanding early lead. The match also includes Gender Doubles, where SDSU (the Aztecs) took an early 3-0 lead in the overall match score. The winner of this pool play match gains a strong position for seeding, moving closer to securing one of the National Championship bids.

When she's discovered by three vampire hunters, Vladimir (Michael Madsen), Katarin (Michelle Rodriguez) and Sebastian (Matt Davis), she manages to convince them to spare her life and join her cause.
