retroplex.us.description: Django believes there is only one path for him to follow when he returns to his hometown and discovers his father has been murdered by a ruthless gang. (Action, Western) - 1967

retroplex.us.title: Oklahoma Annie
retroplex.us.description: Judy Canova (Judy Canova) is a capable cowgirl and a sassy shopkeeper in her frontier town. But, once she spies the dashing new town sheriff, Dan Fraser (John Russell), Judy decides to branch out into catching crooks to garner his notice. With her daring behavior and bravery, she soon earns a deputy's badge, allowing her to spend time with her favorite lawman. But, when Dan is abducted by a band of wild outlaws, it's up to Judy to round up a posse and save the day. (Western, Comedy) - 1952

retroplex.us.title: The Unforgiven
retroplex.us.description: The Zachary family live quietly on a cattle ranch in post-Civil War Texas. A stranger (Joseph Wiseman) appears and disturbs their bucolic existence by spreading a malicious rumor that their adopted daughter, Rachel (Audrey Hepburn), is a Kiowa Native American. Soon, the Zachary brothers (Audie Murphy, Burt Lancaster) and their mother (Lillian Gish) must defend themselves from both racist whites and vengeful Kiowa. (Drama, Romance, Western) - 1960

retroplex.us.title: The Blood of Heroes
retroplex.us.description: Another woman joins a future gladiator's band of "juggers" against fighters of the ruling elite. (Action, Science fiction) - 1989

retroplex.us.title: Twice Upon a Yesterday
retroplex.us.description: Victor Bukowski cheats on girlfriend Sylvia Weld, who rebounds and gets engaged to Dave Summers. Wishing he could undo his error, Victor happens upon two otherworldly trash collectors, who send him back in time. He uses the opportunity to woo Sylvia again, while making sure that an attractive woman catches Dave's eye. But his attraction to a waitress, Louise, could ruin Victor's plan to right things with Sylvia. (Comedy drama) - 1998

retroplex.us.title: Border Feud
retroplex.us.description: A feud has broken out over control of a Nevada gold mine, and Sheriff Fuzzy Q. Jones (Al "Fuzzy" St. John) realizes that he needs a steady hand by his side. Good thing Fuzzy is pals with Cheyenne Davis (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), an out-of-towner who specializes in fighting crime. Beckoned by Fuzzy, Cheyenne arrives just as local beauty Carol Condon (Gloria Marlen) is taken captive by one of the warring parties. Cheyenne and Fuzzy will have to act fast in order to free her and defuse the tension. (Western) - 1947

retroplex.us.title: Prairie Badmen
retroplex.us.description: Billy Carson (Buster Crabbe) and his pal, Fuzzy (Al "Fuzzy" St. John), are riding west when they meet a traveling medicine show run by a doctor and his teenage son. Billy discovers that the doctor has a map showing the location of a stash of gold stolen from a local stagecoach company. While both Billy and the doctor favor returning the gold to its owners, the son wants to keep it for himself. When the teen runs off with the map and finds himself chased by outlaws, Billy rides out to save him. (Western) - 1946

retroplex.us.title: Paradise Canyon
retroplex.us.description: Rough-and-tumble federal agent John Wyatt (John Wayne) receives an unusual undercover assignment: He must infiltrate the ranks of an Arizona-based medicine show. Wyatt's boss suspects the show's shifty-eyed proprietor, ex-convict Dr. Carter (Earle Hodgins), of running a massive counterfeiting operation. With the full cooperation of the local authorities, Wyatt poses as a sharpshooter and begins his investigation -- only to fall for Carter's beautiful daughter, Linda (Marion Burns). (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: Flaming Bullets
retroplex.us.description: A criminal syndicate has been illegally freeing convicts, only to murder them after authorities offer reward money for the fugitives' scalps. Texas Rangers Tex Haines (Tex Ritter), Dave Wyatt (Dave O'Brien) and "Panhandle" Perkins (Guy Wilkerson) are charged with catching the thugs, and they hit upon a plan: Dave will get himself put in jail, the thugs break him free and Tex and Panhandle will arrest them. But, when the criminals realize the Rangers are closing in, things turn deadly. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: The Lawless Frontier
retroplex.us.description: The parents of John Tobin (John Wayne) have been murdered, and he wants justice. He sets out to find the killer, the evil gang leader Pandro Zanti (Earl Dwire), who hides from the law with disguises and almost kills old prospector Dusty (George Hayes) and his granddaughter. John rescues them and catches Zanti, only to face criminal charges from lawman Sheriff Williams (Jack Rockwell). Zanti is let go, and John must clear his name and establish who the real criminal is. (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: The Westward Trail
retroplex.us.description: City slicker Ann (Phyllis Planchard) and her little brother Tom (Steve Drake) leave Chicago and buy a ranch out West, and Ann struggles to run things. She meets Larson (Bob Duncan), a crooked local saloon keeper who woos her, but he also wants her land so he can get to the silver that's located on it. As part of his effort to grab all the land he can, Larson kills the town sheriff and assumes his position, alarming good-guy cowboy Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean), who swoops in and tries to rescue Ann. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Texas Terror
retroplex.us.description: Just before Bess (Lucile Browne) returns home to the ranch owned by her father, Dan Matthews, robbers attack him and his friend, Sheriff John Higgins (John Wayne) -- and Dan is killed in the gunfight. Convinced that one of his shots resulted in Dan's death, John resigns as sheriff. Former sheriff Ed Williams (George Hayes) convinces John to work for Bess to make up for his error, and he becomes her foreman. John doesn't confide his involvement in her father's death, but Bess soon hears rumors. (Western) - 1935

retroplex.us.title: Man From Oklahoma
retroplex.us.description: A singing cowboy (Roy Rogers) and his partner (George "Gabby" Hayes) help a woman (Dale Evans) in distress. (Western) - 1945

retroplex.us.title: Susanna Pass
retroplex.us.description: After finding a large oil bed underneath a lake, crooked engineer Del Roberts (Douglas Fowley) plots to take control of a fish hatchery run by Russell Masters (Lucien Littlefield), brother of Roberts' accomplice, Martin Masters (Robert Emmett Keane). Acting sheriff Roy (Roy Rogers) and his deputies square off against Roberts and his henchmen, and visiting female ichthyologist "Doc" Parker (Dale Evans) is caught in the crossfire between the opposing camps. (Western) - 1949

retroplex.us.title: The Star Packer
retroplex.us.description: Loner U.S. Marshal John Travers (John Wayne) foils the hold-up of a stagecoach, rescuing young woman Anita Matlock (Verna Hillie) from the clutches of the crooks and helping her back to town. But there, the sheriff is gunned down by bandits, so Travers starts investigating and connects the murder to a gang, led by an unidentified bandit known as the Shadow, who's been running the town ragged for some time. Travers then makes it his mission to restore order to the town and bring down the Shadow. (Western) - 1934

retroplex.us.title: The Hawk of Powder River
retroplex.us.description: Vivian Chambers (Jennifer Holt) has a secret identity. She moonlights as "the Hawk," a villain who leads a gang of criminals. Vivian's uncle owns a ranch, and she wants to commandeer it. After her uncle catches a glimpse of the Hawk's secret lair, Vivian kills him and decides to go after his daughter, Carole (June Carlson), as well. Now it's up to Deputy Marshal Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) to save Carole and defeat Vivian and her bandit minions. (Western) - 1948

retroplex.us.title: Prairie Outlaws
retroplex.us.description: A retired singing ranger named Eddie Dean (Eddie Dean) and his friends Stormy Day (Al "Lash" La Rue) and Soapy Jones (Roscoe Ates) are asked to jump back into the saddle to protect the construction of a telegraph line across the desert. However, a gang of ruthless thugs led by the villainous Drake Dawson aim to make sure that telegraph line doesn't stay up. In between the gunfights, ambushes, revenge and some valiant heroism, Dean sings a song or two. (Western) - 1946

paranormalfiles.us.title: Unsealed: Alien Files
paranormalfiles.us.description: In April 2011 the FBI declassified decades' worth of secret government documents that contain thousands of reports of UFO sightings and alien activity. Each episode of this half-hour series tackles one alien case by investigating the previously off-limits government files. The program re-examines key evidence and follows developing leads based on newly released information. Mass UFO sightings, personal abductions, government cover-ups, and alien news from around the world are some of the topics covered by the show's panel of specialists, who include journalists, researchers, and radio and TV hosts. After watching an episode of "Unsealed: Alien Files," you may begin to believe that "we are not alone." (Documentary, Paranormal) - 2012-09-17

truehistory.us.title: Native Peoples of North America - Native America: A Story of Survival
truehistory.us.description: The commonly held views of Native Americans and the realities of a tapestry of vibrant cultures; Cobb explains the pitfalls that occur when history does not provide this crucial viewpoint; the mistake of consigning Native Americans to the past. (American history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Native Peoples of North America - The Columbian Exchange: New Worlds for All
truehistory.us.description: The misleading dichotomy of Old World and New World impacts perceptions of Native Americans; the Columbian Exchange is the crux behind the creation of new worlds for all; shaping everything from the fauna and flora to the cuisines of the world. (American history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Native Peoples of North America - The Native South and Southwest in the 1600s
truehistory.us.description: The cultures that exist before the Spanish Invasion; the struggle for power through Hernando de Soto's entrada through the Southeast; the Pueblo War for Independence in the Southwest; the Native American worlds born in the aftermath of these events. (American history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Native Peoples of North America - Werowocomoco and Montaup in the 1600s
truehistory.us.description: How connections are forged between Native Americans and newcomers as they incorporate each other into their worlds; examples across the Northeastern Woodlands down to Werowocomoco; how the search for common ground begins at first contact. (American history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Native Peoples of North America - Iroquoia and Wendake in the 1600s
truehistory.us.description: Once Europeans arrive, the Native peoples of the Northeast want to maintain their autonomy; the strategies and experiences of the Wendat and Iroquois; Native Americans transform the European colonial project while preserving a measured separatism. (American history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Native Peoples of North America - Indian-European Encounters, 1700-1750
truehistory.us.description: An exploration of the Iroquois Confederacy and the Lenape people; Native Americans keep or lose their lands through treaties and negotiations; the repercussions of these conflicts sometimes go beyond relocation, enslavement or near annihilation. (American history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Native Peoples of North America - The Seven Years' War in Indian Country
truehistory.us.description: The French and Indian War is portrayed in history as a turning point for Native nations in the East; for some, it serves as a victory, for others, a defeat; a changed storyline; the perspectives of Native people who experience the era differently. (American history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Native Peoples of North America - The American Revolution through Native Eyes
truehistory.us.description: The Native Americans experience the American Revolution as allies, as participants in their own civil wars and as neutral parties; for many, the resolution of the American Revolution holds little meaning; the rule of the colonists or the Crown. (American history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Three Peoples Collide
truehistory.us.description: Neither the Eurocentric term 'discovery' nor the blandly neutral 'encounters' do justice to the impact of Europeans, Africans and Native Americans coming together in the New World; a collision whose causes and effects are outlined in this lecture. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - The Native Americans
truehistory.us.description: Most of the inhabitants of the Americas arrive in migratory waves from Asia between 40,000 and 2,000 B.C.; their civilizations are based on sophisticated irrigation and farming; complex religions and social structures; rivaling those of Europe. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Mayas, Aztecs, and Incas
truehistory.us.description: The Aztecs and Incas create empires built upon religions of conquest; powered by the control of water, around Lake Texcoco in Mexico and high in the Andes Mountains, respectively; the Maya develops an advanced knowledge of astronomy and mathematics. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Europeans and Africans
truehistory.us.description: Europe and Africa are connected for centuries by Old World trading networks centered around the Mediterranean; in the 15th century, Spain and Portugal shift the trade out of the Mediterranean and into the Atlantic, along the west coast of Africa. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - European Overseas Expansion
truehistory.us.description: In 1492, Europe is dwarfed in power by the civilizations of China, India, the Ottomans of the Middle East and even the empires of Africa; the modern nation-state, capitalism, Christianity and new technologies combine to catapult Portugal. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Christopher Columbus-Path to Conquest
truehistory.us.description: Neither villain nor visionary, Christopher Columbus is an extremely learned and devout man; he embarks on his enterprise of the Indies for gold, glory and gospel; he dies unaware that he has initiated arguably the most important event in history. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Stepping Stones-The Conquest of the Caribbean
truehistory.us.description: Within a generation, the Spanish sweep across the Caribbean Sea and the surrounding regions, conquering and annihilating native peoples, establishing the patterns of conquest that they repeat across the Americas for nearly a century. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - The Rise of Hernán Cortés
truehistory.us.description: In the conquest of Mexico, two empires collide; two mighty figures clash; Hernan Cortes leads a renegade Spanish expedition to the coast of Mexico; he exploits divisions among the various Indian tribes, capturing Montezuma in his own palace. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America - The Unknown Story of Ancient North America
truehistory.us.description: Revealing the truths of ancient North America, which include pyramids, state-of-the-art highways and productive innovators; how the societies seemed destined to remain a mystery due to European conquerors and no written records. (World history) - 2018-06-22

truehistory.us.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America - The First Human Migrations to the Americas
truehistory.us.description: DNA evidence pointing to Asia as the origin of all human migration to North America; migration passages across the Bering Strait; ancient habitation sites across the continent; why scientists cannot yet agree on the ages of the sites. (World history) - 2018-06-22

truehistory.us.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America - Clovis Man: America's First Culture
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the very first American culture, which is identified by a specialized hunting tool called the Clovis point; how the Clovis populated the Americas from coast to coast; how some of the Clovis people evolved into the last Paleo-Indians. (World history) - 2018-06-22

truehistory.us.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America - The Archaic Period: Diversity Begins
truehistory.us.description: How Paleo-Indian culture began to diversify regionally; understanding why some groups developed a hunting and gathering culture, while others fished from temporary camps; what DNA research reveals about one ancient sedentary people. (World history) - 2018-06-22

truehistory.us.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America - Late Archaic Innovations
truehistory.us.description: How the creative yet disparate peoples of North America developed innovations such as corn agriculture, permanent houses and religion about 5,000 years ago; exploring the only innovation common to these many different cultures. (World history) - 2018-06-22

truehistory.us.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America - Poverty Point: North America's First City
truehistory.us.description: How a group of ancient people developed a planned community on more than 900 acres of land to accommodate 4,000 to 5,000 inhabitants; how the city of Poverty Point functioned for 1,000 years and included one of the world's oldest pyramids. (World history) - 2018-06-22

truehistory.us.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America - Medicine Wheels of the Great Plains
truehistory.us.description: Surveying what is known about medicine wheels, which are wagon-wheel type arrangements of stones on the ground that vary in their number of spokes and size; learning their functions and meaning, which almost certainly changed over time. (World history) - 2018-06-22

truehistory.us.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America - Adena Culture and the Early Woodlands Period
truehistory.us.description: The evolution of the continent's first coherent civilizations in Ohio about 3,000 years ago; studying the Adena, the first ancient American culture with a wide-ranging influence; the Adena's conical burial mounds and shared concept of an afterlife. (World history) - 2018-06-22

truehistory.us.title: Native Peoples of North America - Native America: A Story of Survival
truehistory.us.description: The commonly held views of Native Americans and the realities of a tapestry of vibrant cultures; Cobb explains the pitfalls that occur when history does not provide this crucial viewpoint; the mistake of consigning Native Americans to the past. (American history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Native Peoples of North America - The Columbian Exchange: New Worlds for All
truehistory.us.description: The misleading dichotomy of Old World and New World impacts perceptions of Native Americans; the Columbian Exchange is the crux behind the creation of new worlds for all; shaping everything from the fauna and flora to the cuisines of the world. (American history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Native Peoples of North America - The Native South and Southwest in the 1600s
truehistory.us.description: The cultures that exist before the Spanish Invasion; the struggle for power through Hernando de Soto's entrada through the Southeast; the Pueblo War for Independence in the Southwest; the Native American worlds born in the aftermath of these events. (American history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Native Peoples of North America - Werowocomoco and Montaup in the 1600s
truehistory.us.description: How connections are forged between Native Americans and newcomers as they incorporate each other into their worlds; examples across the Northeastern Woodlands down to Werowocomoco; how the search for common ground begins at first contact. (American history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Native Peoples of North America - Iroquoia and Wendake in the 1600s
truehistory.us.description: Once Europeans arrive, the Native peoples of the Northeast want to maintain their autonomy; the strategies and experiences of the Wendat and Iroquois; Native Americans transform the European colonial project while preserving a measured separatism. (American history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Native Peoples of North America - Indian-European Encounters, 1700-1750
truehistory.us.description: An exploration of the Iroquois Confederacy and the Lenape people; Native Americans keep or lose their lands through treaties and negotiations; the repercussions of these conflicts sometimes go beyond relocation, enslavement or near annihilation. (American history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Native Peoples of North America - The Seven Years' War in Indian Country
truehistory.us.description: The French and Indian War is portrayed in history as a turning point for Native nations in the East; for some, it serves as a victory, for others, a defeat; a changed storyline; the perspectives of Native people who experience the era differently. (American history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Native Peoples of North America - The American Revolution through Native Eyes
truehistory.us.description: The Native Americans experience the American Revolution as allies, as participants in their own civil wars and as neutral parties; for many, the resolution of the American Revolution holds little meaning; the rule of the colonists or the Crown. (American history) - 2016-10-21

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Three Peoples Collide
truehistory.us.description: Neither the Eurocentric term 'discovery' nor the blandly neutral 'encounters' do justice to the impact of Europeans, Africans and Native Americans coming together in the New World; a collision whose causes and effects are outlined in this lecture. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - The Native Americans
truehistory.us.description: Most of the inhabitants of the Americas arrive in migratory waves from Asia between 40,000 and 2,000 B.C.; their civilizations are based on sophisticated irrigation and farming; complex religions and social structures; rivaling those of Europe. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Mayas, Aztecs, and Incas
truehistory.us.description: The Aztecs and Incas create empires built upon religions of conquest; powered by the control of water, around Lake Texcoco in Mexico and high in the Andes Mountains, respectively; the Maya develops an advanced knowledge of astronomy and mathematics. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Europeans and Africans
truehistory.us.description: Europe and Africa are connected for centuries by Old World trading networks centered around the Mediterranean; in the 15th century, Spain and Portugal shift the trade out of the Mediterranean and into the Atlantic, along the west coast of Africa. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - European Overseas Expansion
truehistory.us.description: In 1492, Europe is dwarfed in power by the civilizations of China, India, the Ottomans of the Middle East and even the empires of Africa; the modern nation-state, capitalism, Christianity and new technologies combine to catapult Portugal. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Christopher Columbus-Path to Conquest
truehistory.us.description: Neither villain nor visionary, Christopher Columbus is an extremely learned and devout man; he embarks on his enterprise of the Indies for gold, glory and gospel; he dies unaware that he has initiated arguably the most important event in history. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - Stepping Stones-The Conquest of the Caribbean
truehistory.us.description: Within a generation, the Spanish sweep across the Caribbean Sea and the surrounding regions, conquering and annihilating native peoples, establishing the patterns of conquest that they repeat across the Americas for nearly a century. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Conquest of the Americas - The Rise of Hernán Cortés
truehistory.us.description: In the conquest of Mexico, two empires collide; two mighty figures clash; Hernan Cortes leads a renegade Spanish expedition to the coast of Mexico; he exploits divisions among the various Indian tribes, capturing Montezuma in his own palace. (Educational, History) - 2002-01-28

truehistory.us.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America - The Unknown Story of Ancient North America
truehistory.us.description: Revealing the truths of ancient North America, which include pyramids, state-of-the-art highways and productive innovators; how the societies seemed destined to remain a mystery due to European conquerors and no written records. (World history) - 2018-06-22

truehistory.us.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America - The First Human Migrations to the Americas
truehistory.us.description: DNA evidence pointing to Asia as the origin of all human migration to North America; migration passages across the Bering Strait; ancient habitation sites across the continent; why scientists cannot yet agree on the ages of the sites. (World history) - 2018-06-22

truehistory.us.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America - Clovis Man: America's First Culture
truehistory.us.description: Exploring the very first American culture, which is identified by a specialized hunting tool called the Clovis point; how the Clovis populated the Americas from coast to coast; how some of the Clovis people evolved into the last Paleo-Indians. (World history) - 2018-06-22

truehistory.us.title: Ancient Civilizations of North America - The Archaic Period: Diversity Begins
truehistory.us.description: How Paleo-Indian culture began to diversify regionally; understanding why some groups developed a hunting and gathering culture, while others fished from temporary camps; what DNA research reveals about one ancient sedentary people. (World history) - 2018-06-22

classica.us.title: Eine Hommage an Wien
classica.us.description: Am 9. März 2011 zollten die Wiener Philharmoniker ihrer Heimatstadt mit einem Walzer-Konzert Tribut. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2021-08-20

classica.us.title: Gershwin - Greatest Hits
classica.us.description: Der belgische Dirigent Jos van Immerseel leitet Anima Eterna Brugge in einem Konzertprogramm, das dem amerikanischen Komponisten George Gershwin gewidmet ist. Die Aufführung wurde am 3. März 2017 im Concertgebouw Brügge, Belgien, aufgezeichnet. (Special, Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-02-12

classica.us.title: Werke von Beethoven und Saint-Saëns
classica.us.description: Im Jahr 2021 feiert Martha Argerich ihren 80. Geburtstag mit einem Konzert im Château de Chantilly, Frankreich. Bei diesem Konzert wird Argerich von dem Cellisten Mischa Maisky, dem Geiger Maxim Vengerov und dem Pianisten Iddo Bar-Shaï begleitet. (Music, Concert, Classical) - 2024-12-06

classica.us.title: Patmos - Ein musikalischer Dokumentarfilm
classica.us.description: Jeden Sommer findet auf der griechischen Insel Patmos das Patmos Musikfestival statt, ein Ereignis, das sowohl ein Kammer- als auch ein Sakralmusikfestival umfasst. Dieser Film dokumentiert die Ausgabe von 2024 und zeigt Auftritte von renommierten Solisten und Ensembles aus aller Welt. Zum Programm gehört unter anderem der künstlerische Leiter des Festivals und Pianist Roberto Prosseda. In Interviews teilen mehrere Künstler ihre Erfahrungen mit diesem Festival und die Atmosphäre der Insel. (Special, Documentary, Musical) - 2026-01-03

classica.us.title: Händel auf Schloss Chambord
classica.us.description: Hervé Niquet und das Ensemble Concert Spirituel spielen "Te Deum" von Marc-Antoine Charpentier. (Special, Documentary, Music, Classical) - 2016-09-09

classica.us.title: Berg - Klaviersonate, op. 1
classica.us.description: Der italienische Pianist Andrea Molteni spielt Alban Bergs Klaviersonate in h-Moll, Op. 1. Molteni begann mit sechs Jahren mit dem Klavierspiel. Er schloss das Conservatorio di Musica Giuseppe Verdi di Como mit Auszeichnung und Ehrennennung ab. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-04-12

classica.us.title: Classica Spotlight
classica.us.description: Filmische klassische Clips und energiegeladene Konzertstücke mit aufstrebenden Künstlern. (Special, Event, Music) - 2022-05-31

classica.us.title: IVC 2019 - Finale: Duparc, Borodin et al
classica.us.description: Die Mezzosopranistin Esther Valentin und die Pianistin Anastasia Grishutina führen Henri Duparcs "L'invitation au voyage" auf. Diese Aufführung wurde im Theater aan de Parade in 's-Hertogenbosch, Niederlande, aufgenommen. (Music, Classical) - 2023-04-10

classica.us.title: Bach - 3. Sonate für Violin (BWV 1005)
classica.us.description: Isabelle Faust spielt zwei unglaubliche Solowerke für Violine von J. S. Bach: Partita Nr. 2 in d-Moll BWV 1004 und Sonate Nr. 3 in C-Dur BWV 1005. Beide Werke sind Teil der bekannten Sonaten und Solo-Partiten für Violine des Komponisten. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert) - 2023-05-31

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Streichquartette Nr. 1, 9 & 10
classica.us.description: Das französische Streichquartett Quatuor Ébène feiert den 250. Geburtstag von Ludwig van Beethoven mit der Aufnahme aller sechzehn Streichquartette des Komponisten, aufgeführt in sechs Konzerten in der Philharmonie de Paris im Herbst 2020. (Special, Music, Classical, Event) - 2024-08-10

classica.us.title: Beethoven: Quintett für Klavier und Bläser, Op. 16
classica.us.description: Das Quintett für Klavier und Bläser in Es-Dur, Op. 16, von Ludwig van Beethoven wird im Auditorium Santa Cecilia in Perugia aufgeführt. Das Werk wurde 1796 vollendet und 1801 in zwei Fassungen mit Klavier und Bläsern oder Streichern veröffentlicht. (Music, Classical, Concert) - 2025-04-12

classica.us.title: Approaching the Maelstrom
classica.us.description: Der Dokumentarfilm aus dem Jahr 2019 verfolgt den Prozess, der zu einer Aufnahme der Komposition "A Descent into the Maelström" des US-amerikanischen Komponisten Philip Glass führte. Das Werk basiert auf dem Werk des Schriftstellers Edgar Allan Poe. (Documentary, Music) - 2019

classica.us.title: Chopin - Nocturnes Op. 62
classica.us.description: Roberto Prosseda (1975) spielt Mozarts 5. Klaviersonate und vier Impromptus, Op. 90 von Franz Schubert. Prosseda bringt das Konzert mit einer Interpretation des technisch anspruchsvollen Ballade No. 4, Op. 52 von Chopin zu einem krönenden Abschluss. Er ist besonders für seine Interpretationen einiger kürzlich entdeckter Werke von Mendelssohn und seine 9-teilige CD-Serie über Klavierwerke des Komponisten bekannt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-12-15

classica.us.title: Mahler - 9. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Das Gustav Mahler Jugendorchester wurde im Jahr 1986 gegründet. Heute zählt es zu den besten Jugendorchestern weltweit. Es wurde auf Claudio Abbados Initiative gegründet. Das Repertoire des Orchesters ist stark vom Werk Gustav Mahlers geprägt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2020-04-09

classica.us.title: The Unanswered Ives
classica.us.description: Charles Ives ist ein Mann der Dissonanzen - und das in fast allen Bereichen seines Lebens. Seit seiner Kindheit gilt seine Liebe dem Spiel mit der Musik. Doch Charles wurde zu einer Zeit geboren, als man klassische Musiker für Memmen hielt. (Special, Documentary) - 2019-09-22

classica.us.title: Mozarts 38. Sinfonie, KV 504
classica.us.description: Gerd Albrecht dirigiert die Deutsche Kammerphilharmonie bei einer Aufführung von Mozarts 38. Prager Sinfonie. Mozart komponierte sie Ende 1786, die Premiere fand im Januar 1787 während des ersten Pragbesuchs des Komponisten statt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2019-06-05

classica.us.title: Grieg, Klavierkonzert, Op. 16
classica.us.description: Artur Rubinstein und das London Symphony Orchestra unter der Leitung von André Previn spielen das Klavierkonzert a-Moll op. 16 von Edvard Grieg (1843-1907). Diese Aufnahme entstand im April 1975 in der Fairfield Hall Croydon. Auch im Alter von 88 Jahren schien Artur Rubinstein (1887-1982) nichts von der Lebenslust verloren zu haben, mit der er sein Publikum bereits seit fast einem Dreivierteljahrhundert begeistert hatte. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2012-12-17

classica.us.title: Prokofjew - Peter und der Wolf
classica.us.description: Das weltberühmte sinfonische Märchen von Sergej Prokofjew wird in einer neuen Interpretation präsentiert. Der Dirigent erzählt die Geschichte auf seine Art und wird dabei vom Britten-Pears Orchester musikalisch unterstützt. (Special, Music, Classical, Concert, Event) - 2019-11-16

classica.us.title: Mahler - Sinfonie Nr. 2, 'Auferstehung'
classica.us.description: Orchester und Chor des Maggio Musicale Fiorentino unter der Leitung von Myung-Whun Chung spielen Mahlers Auferstehungssymphonie. Solistinnen sind Christiane Karg, Sopran, und Claudia Huckle, Alt. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2024-08-16

classica.us.title: Mahler - 4. Sinfonie
classica.us.description: Kirill Karabits dirigiert Gustav Mahlers 4. Sinfonie. Als Solistin tritt die Sopranistin Lucy Crowe auf. Seine Vierte Sinfonie beginnt mit Schellenklang, Vogelgezwitscher und einer Melodie, wie direkt aus Mozarts Welt. Alles wirkt wunderbar einfach. (Special, Music, Classical) - 2025-12-20

classica.us.title: Gaming X Symphony: Legends & Quests in Concert
classica.us.description: Das Dänische nationale Symphonieorchester spielt beliebte Kompositionen von legendären Videospielen. Mit dabei sind Melodien aus "The Legend of Zelda", "League of Legends", "Halo", "World of Warcraft" und vielen weiteren Videospielklassikern. (Special, Music) - 2025-07-31

classica.us.title: Beethoven - Klaviersonate Nr. 21 - III
classica.us.description: Julijana Sarac spielt den dritten Satz aus Ludwig van Beethovens Klaviersonate Nr. 21. (Special, Music) - 2023-05-02

classica.us.title: Beethoven - 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, op. 55
classica.us.description: Der Dirigent Fabio Luisi leitet das Dänische Radio-Sinfonieorchester in einer Aufführung von Beethovens 3. Sinfonie in Es-Dur, Op. 55. Neben der fantastischen "Eroica" werden auch Strawinskis Psalmensinfonie und Strauss' "Don Juan" interpretiert. (Special, Entertainment, Music, Concert) - 2020-12-10
